raw.description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES IN THE BUSINESS:


As a Workday Lead Payroll Consultant in Kainos, you’ll work in a team to implement and configure enterprise-scale Workday solutions for our global customer base, typically leading a project workstream. You will build relationships with our customers, shaping and delivering solutions that are aligned to customer needs, fit for purpose and commercially viable. You’ll provide excellent guidance to customers, understanding their business and requirements. You’ll support more junior members of the team and share your knowledge with them.

What we are looking for:


  • Workday Payroll Certification, with a strong understanding of Australian Payroll
    • Strong communicator, able to communicate with customers and colleagues with impact, credibility and empathy, including in a remote working situation. Sound ability to formally present to senior Client audiences
    • Strong commercial awareness and full understanding of project and business dynamics
    • Ability to work to tight deadlines and make sensible decisions under pressure taking a balanced view of Customer demands and Kainos commercials
    • Able to lead a functional workstream on a prime implementation throughout the full project lifecycle
    • Willing and able to act as a role model within the capability and mentor and/or line manage more junior consultants
    • Willing and able to support the sales process including the production of estimates for the delivery of work packages
    • Commercial understanding of utilisation within a services organisation and the importance of these targets
    • Able to rotate through various Workday delivery services, specifically Consulting and Application Management Services
    • For Application Management Services, able to deliver work to meet defined Service Level Agreements
    • Able, if required, to travel to customer sites in the same region (minimal out of region travel may also be required)

    Nice to have:
  • Professional qualifications in your area of expertise

• Experience in post deployment services

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

Position Purpose: Performs a clinical review and assesses care related to mental health and substance abuse. Monitors and determines if level of care and services related to mental health and substance abuse are medically appropriate.

KEY DETAILS: This fully remote role with “Partnerships In Care” supports utilization management and quality improvement efforts by identifying outlier provider performance, conducting comprehensive clinical record reviews, and delivering individualized coaching to providers. The position also synthesizes findings into clear, actionable presentations for providers and health plan leadership. The Schedule is Monday through Friday 8-5 PM eastern, central, mountain, or pacific time zone. Preference will be given to applicants with (1) fully independent behavioral health social work, counseling, or therapy licenses (e.g. LCSW, LMHC, LCPC, LMFT), (2) experience in various mental health settings especially outpatient and residential treatment services, (3) utilization management / review, as well as (4) experience presenting to leadership/providers and advising providers on performance.

  • Evaluates member’s treatment for mental health and substance abuse before, during, and after services to ensure level of care and services are medically appropriate

  • Performs prior authorization reviews related to mental health and substance abuse to determine medical appropriateness in accordance with regulatory guidelines and criteria

  • Performs concurrent review of behavioral health (BH) inpatient to determine overall health of member, treatment needs, and discharge planning

  • Analyzes BH member data to improve quality and appropriate utilization of services

  • Provides education to providers members and their families regrading BH utilization process

  • Interacts with BH healthcare providers as appropriate to discuss level of care and/or services

  • Engages with medical directors and leadership to improve the quality and efficiency of care

  • Formulates and presents cases in staffing and integrated rounds

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience: Requires Graduate of an Accredited School Nursing or Bachelor's degree and 2 – 4 years of related experience.

License to practice independently, and/or have obtained the state required licensure as outlined by the applicable state required.
Master’s degree for behavioral health clinicians required.
Clinical knowledge and ability to review and/or assess treatment plans related to mental health and substance abuse preferred.
Knowledge of mental health and substance abuse utilization review process preferred.
Experience working with providers and healthcare teams to review care services related to mental health and substance abuse preferred.

License/Certification:

  • LCSW- License Clinical Social Worker required or

  • LMHC-Licensed Mental Health Counselor required or

  • LPC-Licensed Professional Counselor required or

  • Licensed Marital and Family Therapist (LMFT) required or

  • Licensed Mental Health Professional (LMHP) required or

  • RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure and/or Compact State Licensure required

Pay Range: $27.02 - $48.55 per hour

Remote - National (85002), United KingdomTravel Sales, Associate - Velocity Black UK (Remote)

Our Mission

We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

About the Role

Velocity Black by Capital One harnesses the power of artificial intelligence, the warmth of human experts and the convenience of the latest interfaces to help high-performance people actualize the full potential of their lives. It's concierge, reimagined for the digital age.

By harnessing 24/7 chat, AI, and mobile payments, we help our customers do more and be more in the digital age. From access to the hottest restaurants to guaranteed upgrades at the world’s finest resorts. Make a custom request through the app and you will be chatting to our team within 1 minute, 24/7/365.

What unites us are the values we share: the relentless pursuit and celebration of excellence, actualising the full potential of our lives, and impacting the world in a positive way.

We are looking for someone passionate about the hospitality industry with strong existing knowledge of what it takes to be the most high-value-add concierge. The ideal candidate will be an energetic, ambitious and determined person who wants to take their career in the customer service and concierge space to the next level.

This role will be working within our travel team, which is one of the world’s fastest-growing travel businesses. You will communicate with clients, suppliers, and fellow team members to provide best-in-class service to our members. You will select relevant accommodation and transportation options and ensure every detail is checked so that members have a stress-free travel experience and create memories that will last a lifetime.

What you’ll do

  • Assisting clients in booking travel ranging from commercial flights to hotels to vacation homes and car rentals

  • Using Global Distribution System (GDS) and other online travel tools to book and communicate with suppliers

  • Working with global suppliers to ensure our clients are receiving the best rates, perks, and service in the market

The skills and experience you need

  • Proven experience at a travel agency

  • Experience using Global Distribution System (GDS) and other online travel booking systems

  • A passion for travel

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

  • Clear verbal and written communication skills

  • Ability to work in high-pressure environment with tight deadlines

  • High level of intuition to anticipate and exceed client needs

  • Flexible working hours - available to work on evenings and weekends

We are committed to creating a level playing field and seek to create teams that are representative of our customers and the communities we serve. We’d love to hear from you if you identify with a typically under-represented group in our industry and are particularly keen to hear from women and ethnic minority candidates.

Where and how you'll work

This is a permanent, remote position. Please note, to be eligible to apply to this role, you must reside in the UK.

What’s in it for you

We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.

In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:

  • Wealth & Future: Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes

  • Holidays: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.

  • Health: Access premium care through our private medical insurance.

  • Family Support: We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.

A full list of our benefits is available here.

What you should know about how we recruit

We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible.

We value diversity, inclusion and belonging at our core. We empower our associates to do great work by creating an inclusive culture—one that values diverse perspectives, fosters collaboration and encourages innovative ideas—and a place where associates of all backgrounds can thrive by bringing their most authentic selves to work. We call this our Culture of Belonging, and it rests at the heart of our business.

Our associate-led Business Resource Groups were created to help support our diverse population and include over 10 groups across our offices. Because each Business Resource Group is as unique as the population it serves, they offer a range of activities, networking opportunities, special events and learning programmes to associates.

Capital One is committed to diversity in the workplace.

If you require a reasonable adjustment, please contact All information will be kept confidential and will only be used for the purpose of applying a reasonable adjustment.

For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to

Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site.

Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. (COPSSC).

Principal Network Engineer

Location: Remote – United States
Job Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

The Principal Network Engineer is a senior technical expert responsible for designing, implementing, optimizing, and supporting complex enterprise network and security environments. This role provides technical leadership for network initiatives across on-premises, cloud, data center, and hybrid environments while ensuring reliability, security, scalability, and performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support scalable and highly available LAN, WAN, data center, cloud, and hybrid network environments.
  • Provide advanced technical expertise in BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD-WAN, VXLAN/EVPN, VPN, QoS, firewalls, and load balancers.
  • Implement and support Azure/cloud networking and hybrid connectivity solutions.
  • Lead complex network troubleshooting, incident resolution, and root-cause analysis.
  • Participate in network architecture, technology evaluation, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain network standards, configuration templates, diagrams, and technical documentation.
  • Implement network security, segmentation, resiliency, and performance improvements.
  • Analyze network performance, capacity, and traffic patterns and recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Cloud, Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Operations teams on complex technical solutions.
  • Work with network vendors, carriers, and technology partners to resolve technical issues and deliver network solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to network engineers.
  • Support large-scale network projects from design through implementation and operational handoff.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise networking and network security.
  • Strong experience with LAN/WAN, cloud networking, data center, SD-WAN, and hybrid environments.
  • Advanced knowledge of routing, switching, network security, and network troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure or other major cloud platforms.
  • Experience with enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting complex network and connectivity issues.
  • Experience leading network projects and providing technical leadership.
  • Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Certifications

  • CCNP / CCIE or equivalent
  • Microsoft Azure networking certifications
  • AWS or Google Cloud networking certifications
  • Other relevant networking or security certifications

POSITION SUMMARY:

The SLP Advocacy Manager helps AbleNet amplify the voice of speech-language pathologists, never replace it. This part-time role(20 hours per week) sits within Customer Experience and further reflects AbleNet’s focus on industry stewardship. It builds relationships with ASHA, state associations, and other professional bodies shaping the future of the profession. It tracks the policy, reimbursement, and workforce issues SLPs face, and brings those perspectives back into AbleNet so every team understands what matters most to the clinicians we serve. The role also partners on broader professional initiatives to strengthen the profession that helps transform lives, helping individuals with disabilities reach their full human potential.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Listen and monitor. Track and analyze major issues affecting the SLP profession at the state and federal level, including reimbursement, device coverage, licensure, telepractice, and workforce trends, to inform AbleNet's response and direction.
  2. Build relationships and partner. Foster relationships with ASHA, state associations, relevant federal agencies, and other key organizations. Support their initiatives through committee involvement, collaboration, and shared resources, always transparently and in line with each organization's ethical standards.
  3. Bring the SLP voice inside AbleNet. Share SLP insights with teams across the company, so decisions reflect what matters to the profession.
  4. Brief leadership. Keep executives informed on emerging and current issues, including state laws, reimbursement changes, and upcoming initiatives.
  5. Translate findings into content. Turn policy and advocacy findings into internal and external content, such as CX talk tracks, advocacy briefs, and policy updates.
  6. Amplify the SLP voice externally. Develop content and identify channels that surface SLP perspectives, keeping SLPs informed about the policy landscape shaping their profession.

CORE COMPETENCIES, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  1. Proactive and Self-Motivated: Demonstrates curiosity, agility, tenacity, and forward thinking. Acts with a sense of urgency and takes initiative without waiting for direction.
  2. Strong Communication Skills: Exhibits strong written and verbal communication, active listening, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  3. Organized and Detail-Oriented: Maintains consistent documentation, structure, and tracking of policy developments, relationships, and communications.
  4. Policy Translation: Proven ability to translate complex policy information into clear, actionable insights for both clinical and executive audiences.
  5. Relationship Building: Able to build and maintain credible relationships with professional associations, advocacy groups, and policy stakeholders.
  6. Collaborative: Works effectively across functions and with teams at all levels of the organization.
  7. Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

​

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  1. Familiarity with ASHA and the broad SLP professional/advocacy landscape
  2. Interest in healthcare/education policy as it relates to speech language pathology
  3. Understanding of healthcare reimbursement and insurance funding processes as they relate to speech-language pathology services
  4. Prior experience in professional advocacy, government relations, or association involvement (e.g. ASHA committee work, state association leadership) is a plus

Education & Experience

  • Master’s degree in Speech-Language Pathology or related
  • Active Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP)
  • 5+ years of clinical SLP experience

Physical, Time, Presence & Other Requirements

Physical:

Customer-Facing Office Environment – Requires regular sitting or standing at a desk, frequent computer keyboarding, and handling customer interactions through phone, email, chat, and/or video conferencing in a professional office setting.

Time:

Part-Time employees are expected to work an average of 20-30 hours per week. Additional hours may be required as necessary.

Presence:

Fully Remote - onsite presence is not expected/will be minimal

Travel:

Occasional (10%) - potential for travel 1-2 times quarterly for onsite visits and trainings

Other:

This position will occasionally require evening work to attend advocacy meetings, state-led meetings, or related events held outside the standard 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. schedule. These occasions are intermittent rather than a regular part of the weekly schedule.

raw.description:
Role Overview

Encoura is seeking a Manager or Director, Talent Management & Development to own how our people experience working here and how they are developed over time. This role ensures the alignment of talent programs with organizational objectives to retain and grow top talent. Encoura brought three organizations together over the past year. We now have roughly 800+ employees and a population that brings three different companies’ sets of expectations.

You will partner cross-functionally across the organization to cultivate a high-performance, inclusive culture that supports long-term business growth. You will also lead two experienced Talent Development professionals. Year one is focused by design: performance management, engagement and culture, and the roadmap for what comes next. We would rather do three things properly now than six things partially.

We are open to hiring this role at either the Manager or Director level based on the selected candidate's experience, leadership scope, and organizational impact. Both levels share the same core responsibilities, with placement reflecting the candidate's demonstrated ability to lead initiatives and drive organizational outcomes. This is a full-time, salaried position reporting to the Chief People Officer.

A Day in the Life

This year, FY27, you will:

  • Develop and execute an integrated talent management and development strategy aligned with organizational goals and values
  • Own the performance management cycle end to end in Lattice — goal setting, check-ins, review cycles, and calibration — and make it a process managers use rather than a process they complete
  • Own engagement and culture. Design and run how we listen, turn the results into action plans that sit with the leaders who can act on them, and follow through until something changes
  • Keep the existing learning stack running — Litmos, Articulate/Rise — and administer training where it is needed today, while assessing what we should consolidate
  • Partner with the Chief People Officer on talent gap and capacity planning, bringing data that shows where the organization is thin before it becomes a vacancy
  • Collaborate with leaders to assess organizational capability needs and implement programs that build critical skills and leadership pipelines
  • Own our manager guides from your first day. The step-by-step guides managers use to coach, document, and correct performance will be written before you start. Measuring whether managers use them, where they get stuck, and whether they are producing better outcomes is yours — and so is revising them when the evidence says they are not working
  • Lead, coach, and develop two Talent Development professionals
  • Utilize workforce analytics and talent metrics to assess program effectiveness and determine what is working and what is not. Encoura uses Lattice and Domo

FY28 you will design:

  • A succession planning and talent review approach: critical roles, critical talent, honest bench strength, and a defensible view of who is ready for what
  • A leadership development program for a manager population formed from three legacy organizations, many of whom are managing at Encoura for the first time
  • A consolidated learning program with the content, vendors, and analytics behind it
  • An approach for our Student Success population — a high-volume, largely hourly and seasonal workforce whose supervisors need different tools than our corporate managers

Role Progression

  • Within 1 month, you'll: Know the talent team and will have partnered with the CPO to create the FY27 team objectives. Have met the leaders whose groups are undergoing change and planned how best to support them.
  • Within 3 months, you'll: Have the FY27 performance cycle designed and scheduled, have a measurement approach in place for the manager guides, and have an agreed approach to engagement with the Chief People Officer.
  • Within 6 months, you'll: Have the performance cycle running, have a first engagement read with action plans owned by named leaders, and have an FY28 talent roadmap that leadership can fund.

About You

  • Level will be determined by experience and demonstrated scope:
    • Manager level: 5+ years in talent management, organizational development, or learning and development, including hands-on design and delivery of performance or leadership programs, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
    • Director level: 8+ years of progressive experience in talent management, organizational development, or related HR functions, including ownership of enterprise-wide talent programs and experience leading a team.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field with equivalent experience; Master's degree preferred
  • Demonstrated experience designing and running a performance management cycle that managers across an organization actually completed, and a clear view of why it worked
  • Experience owning employee engagement end to end — not just fielding a survey but turning results into action that leaders carried and that employees could see
  • Experience building succession plans and running talent reviews with senior leaders, including the uncomfortable conversations about readiness. This is FY28 work here, and we want someone who has done it before they design it
  • Strong consultative skills and the standing to tell a leader that the approach they want is the wrong one, and to be heard
  • Comfort with talent data and the discipline to measure program effect rather than program activity
  • Hands-on experience with Lattice or a comparable performance and engagement platform, and with at least one learning management or content authoring system
  • Experience in a recently merged, acquired, or integrating organization strongly preferred. You will be building shared practice across three cultures that have not finished becoming one
  • Experience supporting a distributed or high-volume hourly workforce preferred
  • Experience in higher education or education technology preferred
  • Successful candidates will be required to complete and pass a CLEAR™ identity verification as part of the pre-employment screening process. CLEAR™ Candidate FAQ
    • CLEAR™ Candidate FAQ

The annual base salary range for this exempt position is $120,000–$140,000 andreflects the midpoint through maximum of the established range for this role. Encoura establishes compensation using national market data, internal equity considerations, and organizational budget factors to ensure fairness and consistency across the organization. Certain roles may also be eligible for variable compensation in addition to base salary.

Employees in this role are eligible for Encoura’s comprehensive benefits package, which includes health insurance, retirement contributions, paid time off, and other programs that support employee well‑being.

About  Us

Encoura’s mission is to empower students and institutions to create meaningful connections so everyone can make the most informed decisions to achieve their goals. Since 1972, the Company has evolved its products and services to better represent the link between students and higher education institutions and to create the highest probability of student success. 

Encoura’s expertise now spans enrollment, research, marketing, student success, and advancement and provides an unmatched combination of higher education experience and innovative solutions for colleges and universities. The Company also offers Encourage® — the nation’s largest free college and career planning program used by millions of high school students and educators nationwide. 

It is the policy of the Company to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. All applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. 

Encoura endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability and need an alternative method for applying, please contact the Talent Team.

Location: within European time zones.

About Pet Media Group

Pet Media Group (PMG) acquires, launches and develops leading pet and equestrian marketplaces around the world. We operate eight brands across seven markets in the UK, US, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. Every year, 1.7 million pets and horses find a new home through our platforms, and our flagship platforms include Pets4Homes.co.uk, Deine-Tierwelt.de and Lancasterpuppies.com.

The pet rehoming experience has remained largely unchanged for decades. At PMG, we're on a mission to transform it by making it more trusted, safe and convenient through technology. We're a driven, ambitious team with a track record of building unicorns, backed by investors such as Verdane. We've been profitable since our first year, so we don't rely on investor capital to grow.

The opportunity

CLM is changing, and we want to rethink what it looks like when AI, automation and customer data sit at the heart of how we work. Our CRM covers email, push, in app and SMS for buyers and breeders across our marketplaces, with more markets joining as the group grows.

As our CRM & Lifecycle Manager, you'll own key parts of the customer lifecycle with our Head of CLM, across strategy, data, automation and execution. You'll spot where engagement can improve, design new journeys and experiments, and build the workflows that bring them to life.

You'll also help shape how the CLM itself works. Successful experiments become repeatable systems, and work that doesn't need a person gets automated.

Your edge is building fast and measuring everything. You use AI daily for research, analysis, segmentation, copy, personalisation and testing, so running several markets does not mean several times the work.

What you will do

  • Own the customer lifecycle. Design journeys for buyers and breeders that respond to what they do, across email, push, in app and SMS.

  • Turn data into action. Dig into behavioural data, spot opportunities and turn them into relevant experiences.

  • Automate the repetitive. Turn manual CRM processes into automated workflows, so time goes to higher value work.

  • Test what AI makes possible. Experiment with personalisation, content and segmentation, measure the results and take what works into production.

  • Build for scale. Create reusable journeys and processes, ready for new markets as the group grows.

  • Work across the business. Partner with product, data, engineering and marketing on the customer experience and the infrastructure behind it.

Requirements

Must have experience

  • 4 or more years in CRM or lifecycle marketing, preferably in house, with campaigns you personally built that moved a metric you can name. Marketplace, consumer app or ecommerce experience is a strong plus.

  • Hands on experience in Customer.io or a comparable platform such as Braze, Iterable or Klaviyo. You're comfortable with segmentation logic, events, attributes and journeys that branch.

  • A habit of measuring. You set up tests properly, read results critically and sanity check a number before anyone else does.

  • Daily, active use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for building, copy, QA, localisation and workflow automation. You have a clear view of what to automate and what stays human.

  • Fluent English, written to a standard that needs no editing before it reaches a customer.

  • Able to own CRM as a team of one when needed: briefing agencies and freelancers, holding them to account, and saying "not this week" to requests with a clear reason.

Preferable experience

  • HTML and Liquid for email templates.

  • SQL, or working with a data warehouse and product analytics.

  • Marketing automation beyond the CRM, such as webhooks or tools like n8n.

  • A CRM platform migration.

  • A two sided or reputation exposed marketplace, such as pets, dating, fintech or the gig economy.

You will thrive here if you

  • Have the mindset of a hands on builder rather than a delegator.

  • Believe process serves outcomes, not the other way around.

  • Value clarity, candour and collaboration.

  • Take a roadmap and run with it, without needing daily direction.

  • Are curious beyond CLM and happy to pick up other marketing projects.

  • Are excited by the challenge of scaling one of Europe's most impactful consumer marketplaces.

What we offer

  • Direct access to founders and country leads.

  • A profitable, growing business rather than a slide deck.

  • A diverse team of more than 100 colleagues across the world.

  • Competitive compensation.

raw.title: Permitting Coordinator
raw.excerpt: About Us and Why We’re Hiring At Terra Energy, we’re not just developing renewable energy projects—we’re building a streamlined, scalable operation that can grow efficiently across multiple markets.
raw.description:
About Us and Why We’re Hiring

At Terra Energy, we’re not just developing renewable energy projects—we’re building a streamlined, scalable operation that can grow efficiently across multiple markets.

As we expand in Texas, permitting has become a critical part of our success. Every project depends on accurate submissions, strong relationships with local jurisdictions, and the ability to navigate regulatory requirements without delays.

That’s why we’re looking for a Permitting Coordinator—someone who doesn’t just process permits, but takes ownership of the entire lifecycle and helps us build a more efficient, reliable system.

If you enjoy working with regulations, creating structure, and making complex processes run smoothly, this role is for you.

The Role

This role sits at the core of our operations.

You’ll be responsible for managing the full permitting process across our renewable energy projects in Texas—from initial submission to final approval and Permission to Operate (PTO).

You’ll work closely with internal teams and external authorities to ensure every project is compliant, on time, and properly documented.

This is a detail-driven role with high operational impact—ideal for someone who is organized, proactive, and comfortable navigating regulatory environments.

What You’ll Be Doing

Leading the Permitting Process

You’ll manage the end-to-end permitting lifecycle, ensuring every application is submitted accurately and moves efficiently through approval stages.

You’ll track multiple permits across different jurisdictions, proactively identifying and resolving delays or missing information.

Coordinating Across Teams

You’ll collaborate closely with Engineering, Sales, Project Management, Scheduling, and Inspection teams to ensure projects are fully ready for submission and aligned with current requirements.

Managing Compliance & Documentation

You’ll ensure all permits meet Texas regulatory, technical, and safety standards.

This includes reviewing documentation such as drawings, engineering stamps, and scopes of work, as well as maintaining accurate records across internal systems.

Working with External Authorities

You’ll act as the main point of contact with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), utilities, and third-party partners—facilitating submissions, answering questions, and pushing approvals forward.

Optimizing Processes

You’ll help define and improve permitting workflows by creating SOPs, reducing errors, and identifying ways to speed up approvals.

You’ll also support system improvements and automation efforts to make processes more scalable.

Training & Knowledge Sharing

You’ll act as a resource for internal teams—sharing updates on regulatory changes, providing training, and helping prevent recurring permitting issues.

What We’re Looking For

You’re someone who thrives in structured environments—or enjoys creating structure where it doesn’t exist yet.

You’re detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple moving pieces without losing track.

You likely:

  • Have prior experience with permitting processes in Texas
  • Understand local, state, and utility regulatory requirements
  • Are highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Can manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
  • Communicate clearly with both internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Are comfortable reviewing technical documentation (drawings, plans, etc.)
  • Enjoy improving processes and making systems more efficient

How You’ll Work at Terra Energy

We’re a fast-growing company, and while we move quickly, we rely on strong operational foundations.

You’ll have ownership over your area, direct collaboration with multiple teams, and the opportunity to improve how permitting is handled as we scale.

We value people who are proactive, solution-oriented, and focused on getting things done the right way.

Compensation & Details

  • Salary: $50,000 USD annually
  • Location: Remote (United States)
  • Reports to: Operations Manager
  • Department: Operations

What Success Looks Like

  • Permits are submitted accurately and approved on time
  • Minimal delays due to missing or incorrect documentation
  • Strong relationships with local jurisdictions and utilities
  • Clear, organized tracking of all permitting activities
  • Improved workflows that reduce turnaround times

In Summary

This role is for someone who brings order to complexity.

If you’re excited about managing critical processes, working with regulations, and playing a key role in getting projects across the finish line—this is that kind of opportunity.

Recruitment Process

  • Initial Contact (HR) – Quick intro and role overview
  • HR Interview – Experience and overall fit
  • Hiring Manager Interview – Technical and role deep dive
  • Offer Letter – Final offer and next steps

About the role

At Valtech, we build digital experiences that help the world's leading brands connect with their customers through content, commerce, experimentation, data and AI.

We're looking for a Lead Optimizely Solutions Architect to join our growing Optimizely practice in Canada. In this role, you'll lead the design and delivery of enterprise digital experience platforms, guide multidisciplinary teams, and act as a trusted advisor to clients navigating complex digital transformation initiatives.

This is a highly strategic role that combines architecture, consulting, technical leadership, AI innovation and people management. You'll help shape client roadmaps, support business development efforts, mentor engineers and architects, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure and aligned with business goals.

If you're passionate about Optimizely, modern digital architectures and AI-enabled experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll do

Architecture & Delivery

  • Design enterprise-grade Optimizely solutions that align business objectives, technical requirements and industry best practices.
  • Define scalable architectures across content management, integrations, personalization, analytics and digital experience platforms.
  • Provide technical leadership across multiple concurrent projects and guide teams through complex implementation challenges.
  • Produce architecture documentation, technical specifications and executive-ready presentations.
  • Lead technical discovery efforts, feasibility assessments and risk identification.
  • Support engineering teams with proof-of-concepts, complex implementations and critical technical decisions.
  • Establish and promote best practices around content modeling, headless delivery, security, performance and maintainability.
  • Design integrations across CRM, commerce, CDP, PIM, DAM, analytics and identity ecosystems.
  • Define data collection, event tracking and analytics strategies that drive personalization, experimentation and business insights.

AI Solutions & Innovation

  • Design and deliver AI-enabled experiences and workflows leveraging Optimizely Opal, LLM services and emerging AI technologies.
  • Define governance frameworks and guardrails for AI adoption, including privacy, compliance, content quality and human oversight.
  • Champion AI-assisted software delivery practices, including code generation, testing automation and developer productivity tools.
  • Help clients identify practical AI use cases that create measurable business value across content, marketing and experimentation workflows.

Client Advisory & Consulting

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to enterprise clients.
  • Define technology roadmaps and provide recommendations for platform evolution and modernization.
  • Advise on broader MarTech and enterprise ecosystems, ensuring Optimizely integrates effectively with existing platforms and services.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Delivery Leads and Creative teams to maximize business impact.
  • Communicate architecture decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Practice Growth & Leadership

  • Stay current with the Optimizely product ecosystem, including CMS, Graph, Experimentation, CMP, Commerce and Opal.
  • Contribute to business development activities, solution shaping, client workshops and proposal development.
  • Lead top-down and bottom-up estimation exercises for new opportunities.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to Valtech's offerings, accelerators and delivery standards.
  • Mentor architects and developers while helping define the future direction of the practice.
  • Manage a small team of direct reports, supporting performance, career growth and professional development.

What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise web development, including at least 5 years in a Solution Architect, Technical Architect or similar leadership role.
  • Deep expertise with Optimizely CMS (CMS 12 and/or SaaS CMS), including multiple enterprise implementations delivered as the lead architect.
  • Strong .NET background, including C#, ASP.NET Core, MVC and Optimizely APIs.
  • Experience delivering headless and hybrid architectures using Optimizely Graph and/or Content Delivery API.
  • Front-end integration experience with React, Next.js or similar frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of content modeling, personalization, multisite and multilingual implementations.
  • Experience integrating enterprise platforms including CRM, commerce, CDP, PIM, DAM, search and identity providers.
  • Experience designing analytics and data solutions involving platforms such as Optimizely Data Platform, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Snowflake or BigQuery.
  • Proven experience delivering AI-enabled capabilities in production environments, including LLM integrations, agents and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions.
  • Experience with Optimizely DXP, Azure cloud services, CI/CD pipelines and Git-based development workflows.
  • Experience supporting estimation, solution shaping and pre-sales activities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience leading, mentoring and developing engineering or architecture teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Optimizely Commerce, CMP, Web Experimentation, Feature Experimentation or Opal.
  • Experience with composable architectures and MACH-inspired ecosystems.
  • Exposure to additional headless CMS platforms such as Contentful or Contentstack.
  • Experience with agent frameworks, vector databases or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Optimizely certifications across CMS, SaaS CMS, Commerce, Experimentation or AI products.
  • Cloud architecture certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or TOGAF.
  • AI-related certifications including Azure AI Engineer Associate, AWS Machine Learning Engineer, Claude Architect certifications, or Google Generative AI credentials.

The benefits

This is a full-time position based in Canada. The offered salary range is 110.000 - 160,000 CAD annually, depending on experience and location.

Valtech offers a comprehensive benefits package effective after three months of continuous service:

  • A comprehensive insurance plan, where you can choose the module that best suits your needs—Gold, Silver, or Bronze. The employer may contribute up to 80% of your coverage depending on the selected module. This plan includes short- and long-term disability coverage.
  • Dialogue via Sun Life provides virtual healthcare services, allowing you to consult with a healthcare professional for emergencies, prescription renewals, and more. You also have access to the Employee and Family Assistance Program, as well as a complete mental health support program.
  • A $500 Personal Spending Account, which can be used for healthcare reimbursements, gym memberships, public transit passes, office supplies, or contributions to your RRSP through Valtech.
  • A retirement plan where Valtech will match 100% of your RRSP contributions through a Deferred Profit Sharing Plan (DPSP), up to a maximum of 4%. You can start contributing to your RRSP immediately, and to the DPSP after 3 months. The vesting of the DPSP will be after a 24 months of service.
  • Access to a flexible vacation under Valtech's policy to support your work-life balance, with 5 days available during your probation period and a prorated amount calculated for the remainder of the year.
  • Personal Technology Reimbursement – $30/month for every employee-offered on day 1.
  • We close during the winter holidays and offer flexible scheduling throughout the year, so you can enjoy those sunny Friday afternoons—provided your weekly hours are completed.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is an experience innovation company that unlocks a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

raw.title: Chief Technology & Product Officer
raw.excerpt: About Agentic Defense Solutions Inc Agentic Defense Solutions exists to solve the real problem in mission-critical AI: not better models, but the operational trust layer that makes AI governable, auditable, and safe to deploy in high-consequence environments.
raw.description:
About Agentic Defense Solutions Inc

Agentic Defense Solutions exists to solve the real problem in mission-critical AI: not better models, but the operational trust layer that makes AI governable, auditable, and safe to deploy in high-consequence environments.

Our Mission

Most people think the challenge in mission-critical AI is better models. It isn't. The real problem is there is no control plane for how AI reasons, makes decisions, and executes operations in high-consequence environments.

Agentic Defense Solutions builds the ARIA product family: the operational trust layer for AI where decisions have real-world impact. From the ARIA Platform foundation to the ARIA Hermes application, we provide the infrastructure that makes AI governable, auditable, and safe to deploy so that warfighters, analysts, operators, and decision-makers can leverage AI with confidence.

We believe that AI accountability shouldn't be an afterthought. It should be the foundation. ARIA enforces policy, keeps an immutable audit trail, supports human-in-the-loop, and is built for air-gapped and classified deployment from day one.

About the role
Agentic Defense Solutions, Inc. is seeking a Chief Technology & Product Officer (CTO/CPO) to own the technical and product direction of the company as we build the operational trust layer for AI in high-consequence environments.

This is not a traditional executive role where product strategy and engineering execution are delegated several layers down. We are looking for a deeply technical product and engineering leader who can move comfortably between company strategy, product architecture, customer problems, engineering execution, and the code when necessary.

You will own the evolution of the ARIA product family: defining what we build, why we build it, how the platform is architected, and how our engineering organization delivers it.

The central technical challenge is significant. AI systems are rapidly moving from generating information to reasoning, making decisions, invoking tools, and executing actions. In mission-critical environments, those systems need a control plane that determines what AI can do, how it reasons, which data and tools it can access, when humans must intervene, and how every consequential action can be reconstructed and defended.

That is what we are building.

You will work directly with the CEO and founding team to turn that vision into a category-defining product and technical platform.

What you'll do

Product Strategy & Direction

  • Own product strategy and roadmap across the ARIA product family, translating the company's mission and market opportunity into a coherent product portfolio.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our users — analysts, operators, engineers, decision-makers, and mission leaders — and turn their hardest problems into scalable product capabilities.
  • Decide what belongs in the core platform, what belongs in applications, what should be enabled through partners and integrations, and what we should deliberately not build.
  • Establish product discovery and development processes that allow us to move quickly without becoming a collection of customer-specific features.
  • Work directly with customers and prospective customers to understand workflows, validate product direction, and identify capabilities that can become repeatable platform primitives.
  • Define product success metrics and use customer behavior, deployment experience, and market feedback to continuously refine priorities.
  • Maintain a strong point of view about the evolution of enterprise and mission AI, agentic systems, AI infrastructure, and human-machine collaboration.

Technology & Architecture

  • Own the technical architecture and long-term technology strategy for ARIA.
  • Define the architecture for a platform capable of orchestrating AI reasoning, tools, data, policy, human approvals, memory, and execution across complex workflows.
  • Ensure ARIA can operate across cloud, hybrid, disconnected, air-gapped, and classified environments without fragmenting into separate products.
  • Drive architectural decisions around agent orchestration, model abstraction, data and knowledge infrastructure, distributed systems, APIs, security boundaries, observability, policy enforcement, and auditability.
  • Ensure the platform remains model-agnostic and capable of taking advantage of rapid advances in foundation models, open-source models, inference infrastructure, and agent frameworks.
  • Establish technical standards that allow the platform to scale dramatically in customers, workloads, data volume, integrations, and engineering contributors.
  • Make thoughtful build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions and prevent unnecessary technical complexity.
  • Maintain a high bar for reliability, security, performance, developer experience, and maintainability.

AI & Agentic Systems

  • Lead the company's technical strategy for agentic AI and AI-assisted decision systems.
  • Drive how ARIA approaches reasoning, planning, tool use, context management, memory, evaluation, human-in-the-loop control, and multi-agent workflows.
  • Build systems that make probabilistic AI useful inside environments that require deterministic controls and accountable outcomes.
  • Establish rigorous approaches to AI evaluation, testing, observability, failure analysis, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure customers can understand not simply what an AI system produced, but the reasoning context, evidence, policies, tools, approvals, and actions that led to an outcome.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging models, frameworks, research, and infrastructure and determine where advances should materially change our product or architecture.

Engineering Leadership

  • Build and lead a world-class engineering organization capable of moving with startup speed while delivering software suitable for mission-critical environments.
  • Recruit exceptional engineers, technical leaders, product leaders, and designers as the company scales.
  • Establish an engineering culture centered on technical excellence, ownership, velocity, intellectual honesty, and pragmatic execution.
  • Develop engineering leaders and create an organizational structure that can scale without introducing unnecessary management layers or bureaucracy.
  • Own engineering planning, prioritization, quality, technical debt, and delivery.
  • Establish the development practices, architecture review processes, testing standards, release processes, and operational disciplines necessary to maintain velocity as the platform grows.
  • Remain technically engaged. You do not need to be the person writing every feature, but you should be capable of reviewing architecture, challenging implementation decisions, debugging difficult problems, prototyping ideas, and earning the respect of exceptional engineers.

Customer & Mission Engineering

  • Work directly with customers to understand complex operational environments and translate those requirements into scalable product architecture.
  • Participate in technical demonstrations, architecture discussions, design sessions, and strategic customer engagements.
  • Partner with mission and deployment teams to ensure lessons from implementations rapidly influence the core product.
  • Help customers understand how ARIA fits into their existing data, AI, security, and operational ecosystems.
  • Serve as a senior technical voice with government, commercial, technology, and strategic partners.
  • Balance the urgency of solving immediate customer problems with the discipline required to build a repeatable software platform.

Executive Leadership

  • Serve as a core member of the executive team and help shape company strategy beyond the boundaries of product and engineering.
  • Partner directly with the CEO on company strategy, market positioning, product narrative, organizational design, recruiting, partnerships, and capital allocation.
  • Translate complex technology into a compelling vision for customers, employees, partners, investors, and the broader market.
  • Represent the company's technical vision externally with customers, partners, industry leaders, and the technical community.
  • Help define and defend the category ADS intends to create: the operational trust layer for AI in high-consequence environments.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of progressive software engineering, product engineering, or technology leadership experience, with substantial experience building and leading high-performing engineering organizations.
  • Experience serving as a senior engineering or product/technology leader — such as CTO, CPO, VP Engineering, VP Product, Head of Engineering, Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, or equivalent — with meaningful ownership of both technical direction and product outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience taking sophisticated enterprise software products from concept through production and significant customer adoption.
  • Exceptional technical depth in modern software architecture, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, or similarly complex enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI systems, including LLMs, agent architectures, retrieval and context systems, tool use, model evaluation, and the rapidly evolving AI infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated ability to make consequential architectural decisions while balancing speed, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.
  • Experience building and managing exceptional engineering teams, including recruiting senior technical talent and developing engineering leaders.
  • Strong product instincts and demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into coherent, scalable products.
  • Experience working directly with sophisticated enterprise customers and navigating the tension between customer requirements and product strategy.
  • Ability to operate effectively in an early-stage environment where strategy, architecture, recruiting, customer conversations, and hands-on problem solving frequently happen in the same day.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A track record of shipping.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building AI/ML platforms, developer platforms, data infrastructure, security platforms, workflow/orchestration systems, or other technically sophisticated enterprise software.
  • Experience building products that sit between infrastructure and applications and become foundational components of a customer's technology stack.
  • Experience scaling a product and engineering organization through a period of rapid company growth.
  • Experience with security-sensitive, regulated, mission-critical, or high-availability environments.
  • Familiarity with deployment into government, defense, intelligence, critical infrastructure, or other high-consequence environments.
  • Experience with disconnected, edge, on-premises, or air-gapped deployment models.
  • Experience developing platforms or ecosystems that enable third-party developers, partners, or customers to build on top of a core product.
  • Demonstrated technical thought leadership through open-source contributions, patents, publications, speaking, or recognized leadership within a technical community.

Prior national security experience is valuable, but it is not required. We care more about your ability to build exceptional technology, understand difficult customer problems, lead extraordinary engineers, and learn a complex mission domain quickly.

The Person We're Looking For

  • You are probably uncomfortable being described as purely a CTO, purely a CPO, or purely an engineering executive.
  • You have strong opinions about architecture, but you care about whether customers actually use what you build.
  • You can spend the morning debating the architecture of an agent runtime, the afternoon working through a mission workflow with a customer, and the evening helping recruit an exceptional engineer.
  • You understand that great product organizations do not simply implement requirements. They develop a point of view about the problem, identify the primitives underneath individual customer requests, and build systems that become more valuable as more use cases are added.
  • You are excited by the technical possibilities of AI but skeptical of systems that cannot explain, constrain, evaluate, or govern their behavior.
  • Most importantly, you want to build.

Our Mission

We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

About the Role

Velocity Black by Capital One harnesses the power of artificial intelligence, the warmth of human experts and the convenience of the latest interfaces to help high-performance people actualize the full potential of their lives. It's concierge, reimagined for the digital age.

By harnessing 24/7 chat, AI, and mobile payments, we help our customers do more and be more in the digital age. From access to the hottest restaurants to guaranteed upgrades at the world’s finest resorts. Make a custom request through the app and you will be chatting to our team within 1 minute, 24/7/365.

What unites us are the values we share: the relentless pursuit and celebration of excellence, actualising the full potential of our lives, and impacting the world in a positive way.

We are looking for someone passionate about the hospitality industry with strong existing knowledge of what it takes to be the most high-value-add concierge. The ideal candidate will be an energetic, ambitious and determined person who wants to take their career in the customer service and concierge space to the next level.

This role will be working within our travel team, which is one of the world’s fastest-growing travel businesses. You will communicate with clients, suppliers, and fellow team members to provide best-in-class service to our members. You will select relevant accommodation and transportation options and ensure every detail is checked so that members have a stress-free travel experience and create memories that will last a lifetime.

What you’ll do

  • Assisting clients in booking travel ranging from commercial flights to hotels to vacation homes and car rentals

  • Using Global Distribution System (GDS) and other online travel tools to book and communicate with suppliers

  • Working with global suppliers to ensure our clients are receiving the best rates, perks, and service in the market

The skills and experience you need

  • Proven experience at a travel agency

  • Experience using Global Distribution System (GDS) and other online travel booking systems

  • A passion for travel

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

  • Clear verbal and written communication skills

  • Ability to work in high-pressure environment with tight deadlines

  • High level of intuition to anticipate and exceed client needs

  • Flexible working hours - available to work on evenings and weekends

We are committed to creating a level playing field and seek to create teams that are representative of our customers and the communities we serve. We’d love to hear from you if you identify with a typically under-represented group in our industry and are particularly keen to hear from women and ethnic minority candidates.

Where and how you'll work

This is a permanent, remote position. Please note, to be eligible to apply to this role, you must reside in the UK.

What’s in it for you

We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.

In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:

  • Wealth & Future: Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes

  • Holidays: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.

  • Health: Access premium care through our private medical insurance.

  • Family Support: We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.

A full list of our benefits is available here.

What you should know about how we recruit

We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible.

We value diversity, inclusion and belonging at our core. We empower our associates to do great work by creating an inclusive culture—one that values diverse perspectives, fosters collaboration and encourages innovative ideas—and a place where associates of all backgrounds can thrive by bringing their most authentic selves to work. We call this our Culture of Belonging, and it rests at the heart of our business.

Our associate-led Business Resource Groups were created to help support our diverse population and include over 10 groups across our offices. Because each Business Resource Group is as unique as the population it serves, they offer a range of activities, networking opportunities, special events and learning programmes to associates.

Capital One is committed to diversity in the workplace.

For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to

POSITION SUMMARY:

The SLP Advocacy Manager helps AbleNet amplify the voice of speech-language pathologists, never replace it. This part-time role(20 hours per week) sits within Customer Experience and further reflects AbleNet’s focus on industry stewardship. It builds relationships with ASHA, state associations, and other professional bodies shaping the future of the profession. It tracks the policy, reimbursement, and workforce issues SLPs face, and brings those perspectives back into AbleNet so every team understands what matters most to the clinicians we serve. The role also partners on broader professional initiatives to strengthen the profession that helps transform lives, helping individuals with disabilities reach their full human potential.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Listen and monitor. Track and analyze major issues affecting the SLP profession at the state and federal level, including reimbursement, device coverage, licensure, telepractice, and workforce trends, to inform AbleNet's response and direction.
  2. Build relationships and partner. Foster relationships with ASHA, state associations, relevant federal agencies, and other key organizations. Support their initiatives through committee involvement, collaboration, and shared resources, always transparently and in line with each organization's ethical standards.
  3. Bring the SLP voice inside AbleNet. Share SLP insights with teams across the company, so decisions reflect what matters to the profession.
  4. Brief leadership. Keep executives informed on emerging and current issues, including state laws, reimbursement changes, and upcoming initiatives.
  5. Translate findings into content. Turn policy and advocacy findings into internal and external content, such as CX talk tracks, advocacy briefs, and policy updates.
  6. Amplify the SLP voice externally. Develop content and identify channels that surface SLP perspectives, keeping SLPs informed about the policy landscape shaping their profession.

CORE COMPETENCIES, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  1. Proactive and Self-Motivated: Demonstrates curiosity, agility, tenacity, and forward thinking. Acts with a sense of urgency and takes initiative without waiting for direction.
  2. Strong Communication Skills: Exhibits strong written and verbal communication, active listening, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  3. Organized and Detail-Oriented: Maintains consistent documentation, structure, and tracking of policy developments, relationships, and communications.
  4. Policy Translation: Proven ability to translate complex policy information into clear, actionable insights for both clinical and executive audiences.
  5. Relationship Building: Able to build and maintain credible relationships with professional associations, advocacy groups, and policy stakeholders.
  6. Collaborative: Works effectively across functions and with teams at all levels of the organization.
  7. Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

​

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  1. Familiarity with ASHA and the broad SLP professional/advocacy landscape
  2. Interest in healthcare/education policy as it relates to speech language pathology
  3. Understanding of healthcare reimbursement and insurance funding processes as they relate to speech-language pathology services
  4. Prior experience in professional advocacy, government relations, or association involvement (e.g. ASHA committee work, state association leadership) is a plus

Education & Experience

  • Master’s degree in Speech-Language Pathology or related
  • Active Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP)
  • 5+ years of clinical SLP experience

Physical, Time, Presence & Other Requirements

Physical:

Customer-Facing Office Environment – Requires regular sitting or standing at a desk, frequent computer keyboarding, and handling customer interactions through phone, email, chat, and/or video conferencing in a professional office setting.

Time:

Part-Time employees are expected to work an average of 20-30 hours per week. Additional hours may be required as necessary.

Presence:

Fully Remote - onsite presence is not expected/will be minimal

Travel:

Occasional (10%) - potential for travel 1-2 times quarterly for onsite visits and trainings

Other:

This position will occasionally require evening work to attend advocacy meetings, state-led meetings, or related events held outside the standard 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. schedule. These occasions are intermittent rather than a regular part of the weekly schedule.

raw.excerpt: Role OverviewEncoura is seeking a Manager or Director, Talent Management & Development to own how our people experience working here and how they are developed over time.
raw.description:
Role Overview

Encoura is seeking a Manager or Director, Talent Management & Development to own how our people experience working here and how they are developed over time. This role ensures the alignment of talent programs with organizational objectives to retain and grow top talent. Encoura brought three organizations together over the past year. We now have roughly 800+ employees and a population that brings three different companies’ sets of expectations.

You will partner cross-functionally across the organization to cultivate a high-performance, inclusive culture that supports long-term business growth. You will also lead two experienced Talent Development professionals. Year one is focused by design: performance management, engagement and culture, and the roadmap for what comes next. We would rather do three things properly now than six things partially.

We are open to hiring this role at either the Manager or Director level based on the selected candidate's experience, leadership scope, and organizational impact. Both levels share the same core responsibilities, with placement reflecting the candidate's demonstrated ability to lead initiatives and drive organizational outcomes. This is a full-time, salaried position reporting to the Chief People Officer.

A Day in the Life

This year, FY27, you will:

  • Develop and execute an integrated talent management and development strategy aligned with organizational goals and values
  • Own the performance management cycle end to end in Lattice — goal setting, check-ins, review cycles, and calibration — and make it a process managers use rather than a process they complete
  • Own engagement and culture. Design and run how we listen, turn the results into action plans that sit with the leaders who can act on them, and follow through until something changes
  • Keep the existing learning stack running — Litmos, Articulate/Rise — and administer training where it is needed today, while assessing what we should consolidate
  • Partner with the Chief People Officer on talent gap and capacity planning, bringing data that shows where the organization is thin before it becomes a vacancy
  • Collaborate with leaders to assess organizational capability needs and implement programs that build critical skills and leadership pipelines
  • Own our manager guides from your first day. The step-by-step guides managers use to coach, document, and correct performance will be written before you start. Measuring whether managers use them, where they get stuck, and whether they are producing better outcomes is yours — and so is revising them when the evidence says they are not working
  • Lead, coach, and develop two Talent Development professionals
  • Utilize workforce analytics and talent metrics to assess program effectiveness and determine what is working and what is not. Encoura uses Lattice and Domo

FY28 you will design:

  • A succession planning and talent review approach: critical roles, critical talent, honest bench strength, and a defensible view of who is ready for what
  • A leadership development program for a manager population formed from three legacy organizations, many of whom are managing at Encoura for the first time
  • A consolidated learning program with the content, vendors, and analytics behind it
  • An approach for our Student Success population — a high-volume, largely hourly and seasonal workforce whose supervisors need different tools than our corporate managers

Role Progression

  • Within 1 month, you'll: Know the talent team and will have partnered with the CPO to create the FY27 team objectives. Have met the leaders whose groups are undergoing change and planned how best to support them.
  • Within 3 months, you'll: Have the FY27 performance cycle designed and scheduled, have a measurement approach in place for the manager guides, and have an agreed approach to engagement with the Chief People Officer.
  • Within 6 months, you'll: Have the performance cycle running, have a first engagement read with action plans owned by named leaders, and have an FY28 talent roadmap that leadership can fund.

About You

  • Level will be determined by experience and demonstrated scope:
    • Manager level: 5+ years in talent management, organizational development, or learning and development, including hands-on design and delivery of performance or leadership programs, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
    • Director level: 8+ years of progressive experience in talent management, organizational development, or related HR functions, including ownership of enterprise-wide talent programs and experience leading a team.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field with equivalent experience; Master's degree preferred
  • Demonstrated experience designing and running a performance management cycle that managers across an organization actually completed, and a clear view of why it worked
  • Experience owning employee engagement end to end — not just fielding a survey but turning results into action that leaders carried and that employees could see
  • Experience building succession plans and running talent reviews with senior leaders, including the uncomfortable conversations about readiness. This is FY28 work here, and we want someone who has done it before they design it
  • Strong consultative skills and the standing to tell a leader that the approach they want is the wrong one, and to be heard
  • Comfort with talent data and the discipline to measure program effect rather than program activity
  • Hands-on experience with Lattice or a comparable performance and engagement platform, and with at least one learning management or content authoring system
  • Experience in a recently merged, acquired, or integrating organization strongly preferred. You will be building shared practice across three cultures that have not finished becoming one
  • Experience supporting a distributed or high-volume hourly workforce preferred
  • Experience in higher education or education technology preferred
  • Successful candidates will be required to complete and pass a CLEAR™ identity verification as part of the pre-employment screening process. CLEAR™ Candidate FAQ
    • CLEAR™ Candidate FAQ

The annual base salary range for this exempt position is $120,000–$140,000 andreflects the midpoint through maximum of the established range for this role. Encoura establishes compensation using national market data, internal equity considerations, and organizational budget factors to ensure fairness and consistency across the organization. Certain roles may also be eligible for variable compensation in addition to base salary.

Employees in this role are eligible for Encoura’s comprehensive benefits package, which includes health insurance, retirement contributions, paid time off, and other programs that support employee well‑being.

About  Us

Encoura’s mission is to empower students and institutions to create meaningful connections so everyone can make the most informed decisions to achieve their goals. Since 1972, the Company has evolved its products and services to better represent the link between students and higher education institutions and to create the highest probability of student success. 

Encoura’s expertise now spans enrollment, research, marketing, student success, and advancement and provides an unmatched combination of higher education experience and innovative solutions for colleges and universities. The Company also offers Encourage® — the nation’s largest free college and career planning program used by millions of high school students and educators nationwide. 

It is the policy of the Company to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. All applicants must be eligible to work in the U.S. 

Encoura endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability and need an alternative method for applying, please contact the Talent Team.

.
