raw.description:
Criminal Productions is looking for a temporary full-time Podcast Video & Social Media Producer to join our team.

As a Podcast Video & Social Producer you will be responsible for creating video and social content for our digital platforms. This will range from producing long-form video interviews to short-form social media video clips. You will also create additional social content including image assets, stories/reels, and caption copy. You will work closely with the podcast producers and the podcast marketing team to reflect Criminal Productions’ voice, spirit, and brand.

WHO WE ARE

Criminal Productions is the home of the podcast Criminal - as well as the podcasts This is Love, Phoebe Reads a Mystery, and their newest podcast: Please Continue with Phoebe and Lauren.

Criminal is one of the most-listened to podcasts in the United States, and has been called “the thinking person’s true crime podcast.” Founded in 2014, Criminal has been praised by the ACLU of New York, The New York Times, Entertainment Weekly, and by the former Prime Minister of New Zealand, Jacinda Ardern.

In 2018, the Criminal team launched This is Love.Time Magazine says, “The podcast tries to decode the mystery of how our romances, obsessions, and relationships drive us. Listening to it can feel like a contact high.” Phoebe Reads a Mystery features Criminal and This is Love host Phoebe Judge reading some of her favorite books in the public domain - from Sherlock Holmes to Little Women.

Please Continue is our newest venture - an “unserious” chat show featuring Phoebe Judge and Criminal co-creator Lauren Spohrer in conversation about everything from offbeat crime stories to Costco shopping tips. One listener called their dynamic “comedy gold.”

Criminal Productions is part of Vox Media. As a community of journalists and storytellers, business professionals, creators, and technologists, we believe it is a moral and business imperative to amplify voices: to cultivate diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout our organization and media. This applies to our candidates, our teams, our storytelling, our creative work, and our platforms, products, and partnerships.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Produce longform video content for Criminal’s YouTube channel from start to finish (coordinating recording, making initial editorial cuts and decisions, working with a video editor on drafts, and publishing a final version)
  • Produce shortform video content for Criminal’s YouTube shorts channel, as well as social media platforms - translating podcast moments into compelling visual stories
  • Upload archival Criminal podcast episodes to YouTube
  • Create compelling thumbnails, titles and copy for YouTube videos (including shorts)
  • Coordinate and collaborate with show producers to create a social media plan around promoting new episodes across all of our podcasts, as well as upcoming events, important initiatives, and more
  • Develop and produce engaging social content for each Criminal Productions show— including image assets, GIFs, stories/reels, motion graphics, video cut-downs of episodes, and platform-specific variants
  • Optimize content for platform performance (length, format, captioning, hashtags, thumbnails, CTAs) and stay current with algorithm changes and emerging formats
  • Track performance metrics (views, reach, engagement, follower growth, click-throughs to episode/subscribe) and feed insights back into creative strategy
  • Maintain an archive of assets and templates, and iterate efficiency in production workflows

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Demonstrated ability to produce both longform and shortform video content, especially for talk-based or interview-driven formats
  • Excellent storytelling instincts; knowing which moments to spotlight that hook viewers, evoke emotion or insight, and prompt engagement or action
  • Strong understanding of social platforms and their nuances: Instagram (feed, stories, reels), TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook - including what drives performance, how users engage, and what makes shows grow
  • A collaborative, consultative working style and the ability to plug into existing teams to help elevate their visual presence.
  • Solid skills in editing short-form video tools (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects) and comfort with static image design (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva) and motion graphic templates
  • Ability to manage multiple projects/shows simultaneously, prioritize under tight deadlines, and collaborate closely with teammates
  • Attentiveness to performance metrics and a willingness to adjust accordingly
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience working in podcast media or editorial-driven media brands
  • Familiarity with audio editing or podcast production workflows a plus

This is a temporary, 6-month, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life. This role is a part of the Vox Media Union, represented by the Writers Guild of America, East.

This job is remote. We are flexible on your work location, but we expect the candidate to work East Coast business hours (9 am - 5 pm Eastern Time).

PAY TRANSPARENCY

The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.

Pay Range
$81,000—$100,000 USD

OUR DEI COMMITMENT

Vox Media is committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can show up as their authentic selves and create their best work. We recognize that great stories, platforms, products and services come from people with all manner of backgrounds and experiences. We recognize that our commitments require ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices.

Vox Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer and qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law. Vox Media will also consider all qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable Fair Chance laws. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations as part of the application process to candidates with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation as part of the application process, please contact our recruiting team ().

WHAT COMES NEXT

Our recruiting team will go through applications in a timely manner. Please note that our recruiting team will only contact you from @ email addresses, never via text message. Read more about how our recruiting team operates, and how to protect yourself from recruitment fraud, here.

The Cybersecurity Assessment and Authorization Analyst provides support to the Department of Health and Human Services, Indian Health Service (IHS). This position is responsible for executing and assisting in the completion of security certifications and for providing support in the development and implementation of a program to manage all aspects of compliance with government regulations

Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc. serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Technology, Infrastructure & Engineering, Health, Manufacturing, Public Safety, Consulting, and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical - Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.

As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act.

Essential Requirements

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required customer clearance for access to systems, facilities, equipment and property.

  • CAP, CISSP, CISM, CISA, SANS GIAC, Security+, Network+, Linux+, MCSE, CCNA or SSCP certifications preferred.

  • In depth knowledge of NIST SP 800 series and FedRAMP guidance and standards.

  • Highly organized with ability to effectively manage multiple projects and priorities.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and to learn and apply new knowledge and techniques related to incident response and continuous monitoring capabilities.

  • Ability to effectively work both independently and in a team environment for the successful achievement of goals.

  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills with ability to prepare quality reports and effectively communicate / interact with a wide variety of technical and non-technical audiences (i.e., customers, team members, management, and federal staff).

  • Excellent critical thinking skills with ability to identify, analyze and resolve problems / complex issues.

  • Working knowledge and understanding of OMB, FISMA, FIPS, HIPPA and other federal regulations and requirements associated with Information Security.

  • Knowledgeable of security-related processes with respect to Federal risk and compliance regulations best practices.

  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common information systems security documents.

  • Expert computer skills with advanced proficiency in a Windows and Linux based computer environment.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Conducts annual security controls effectiveness testing. Documents findings and advises and monitors remediation efforts on all systems in accordance with established policy and procedures.

Conducts significant research, evaluation, recommendation, and documentation development such as security assessment reports, methodologies, briefings, and presentations.

Conducts information security audits/risk assessments on customer systems and network and documents in accordance with NIST, Risk Management Guide for Information Technology Systems.

Annually reviews and updates the security and contingency plan for each system in conjunction with security audits and makes recommendations to address deficiencies.

Assists system owners in developing security authorization packages that are fully compliant with National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) guidelines and organizational defined standards.

Evaluates the implementation of security controls as required by NIST. Prepares security authorization packages using approved customer templates.

Assists in meeting mandates, directives, reporting, and other security-related processes with respect to Federal regulations such as FISMA; Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA); Office of Management and Budget (OMB) mandates; Homeland Security Presidential Directives (HSPD); Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) and NIST guidance implementation, oversight, and compliance.

Reviews and updates risk assessments when significant changes occur to systems/network.

Ensures customer information and information systems are adequately protected from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, or destruction. Briefs and provides documented results to staff. Briefs include, at a minimum, areas of conformance to directives, corrective recommendations for deficiencies, and POA&M explanations to correct deficiencies.

Analyzes major IT systems, from a security perspective, during the initial phases of system development and throughout the systems development lifecycle.

Reviews standard security configurations to assure compliance with federal directives and industry best practices.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field of study and a minimum of five (5) years’ relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education / experience.

Our client is a fast-growing B2B SaaS company hiring a backend engineer to own its data deletion and suppression pipeline — the system that handles privacy requests end to end, from any channel, at scale.

Your first major milestone: building and shipping a new system to handle DROP (California privacy deletion requests). Beyond that, you'll own compliance tooling for GDPR, CCPA, and whatever regulations come next.

This is not a role where "move fast and break things" applies. A mistake in a regular feature means a bug in production; a mistake here can mean a lawsuit. We're looking for someone who takes correctness seriously and treats this responsibility with the weight it deserves.

What You'll Do

  • Own the privacy request pipeline end to end: data deletion, suppression, and audit across all channels
  • Design compliance workflows that scale with evolving regulations (GDPR, CCPA, and future frameworks)
  • Work with large, business-critical databases containing high volumes of records
  • Write thoroughly tested, verifiable code — testing discipline is a core part of this job, not an afterthought

What We're Looking For

Must have:

  • 5 years of backend engineering experience with Node.js and Python
  • At least 2 years of experience working with Data Privacy work (GDPR, CCPA)
  • Hands-on experience with NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Elasticsearch)
  • Comfort working with data at scale — large databases with high record counts
  • A correctness-first mindset: careful, rigorous, and serious about getting things right the first time
  • Strong testing habits — you verify your work before it ships

Nice to have:

  • Elasticsearch experience specifically (deep indexing expertise not required — you can learn the specifics on the job if you know NoSQL fundamentals)
  • Some data engineering exposure
  • Prior experience with privacy/compliance systems (GDPR, CCPA, data subject requests)

Not required:

  • Frontend or accessibility work — this role is purely about the data side of privacy compliance (deletion pipelines, suppression, cookies/consent data), not UI

Why This Role Matters

Privacy regulation is only expanding, and this system sits directly in the path of legal risk. It's a role with clear ownership, real stakes, and visible impact — and a well-scoped technical domain where doing careful, high-quality work is genuinely valued over raw speed.

We offer

  • Remote within Europe.
  • Small, autonomous team — no micromanagement.
  • Competitive B2B compensation.

At ICF Next, we are fearless in finding new ways to solve problems, relentless in making sure it pays off for our clients and committed to making a positive change in the world.

Join our community of mission-driven creatives, communicators, strategists, and technologists to challenge the status quo.


The Team

You'll work as part of a cross-functional team of frontend and full-stack engineers, user experience designers and researchers, solution architects, quality assurance specialists, accessibility experts, business analysts, product managers, data analysts, security specialists, and behavioral health subject matter experts. We partner with federal stakeholders to operate and modernize a mission-critical data collection and performance reporting platform used by grantees and program staff.


The Work

In this individual contributor role, you will build responsive, accessible, and maintainable interfaces for complex data collection and reporting workflows. You will translate user experience designs into production-ready components, connect interfaces to .NET services and REST APIs, implement client-side validation and workflow behavior, and write automated tests that support dependable releases.

A key part of the work is improving the usability and consistency of an active federal application while it continues to serve current users. You will help modernize legacy interfaces incrementally, strengthen the component and design system, improve performance and accessibility, and collaborate closely with backend engineers, designers, testers, product teams, and users.


  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop and maintain responsive web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or TypeScript, and a modern component-based framework or library.
  • Translate user experience designs, prototypes, and acceptance criteria into reusable, accessible, and production-ready components.
  • Build complex forms, client-side validation, data tables, workflow interactions, notifications, and reporting interfaces for data-intensive applications.
  • Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs, authentication services, analytics, and backend capabilities implemented in .NET.
  • Write and maintain unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end tests for user interface behavior and critical workflows.
  • Apply semantic HTML, keyboard support, screen-reader compatibility, color and focus requirements, Section 508, and WCAG standards throughout development.
  • Improve frontend performance, browser compatibility, error handling, usability, and maintainability through measurement and iterative refinement.
  • Participate in Agile planning, estimation, code reviews, demonstrations, release activities, and user acceptance testing support.
  • Collaborate with design, accessibility, backend engineering, quality assurance, security, product, and client stakeholders.
  • Maintain documentation for components, interaction patterns, build tooling, testing, and frontend development standards.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, design technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years developing and supporting resilient, well-tested web applications using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or TypeScript, including browser debugging.
  • 2+ years integrating REST APIs and JSON, with working knowledge of HTTP and HTTPS/TLS.
  • 2+ years using React, Angular, Vue, or a comparable framework to build responsive layouts, reusable components, and complex forms with conditional behavior, client-side validation, and error handling.
  • 1+ year applying accessible development practices, including semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, and focus management, with working knowledge of Section 508 or WCAG requirements.
  • 1+ year writing automated frontend unit tests, with exposure to integration and end-to-end testing, and using package managers, build tools, and Git-based workflows, including pull requests and code reviews.
  • Authorization to work in the United States, ability to perform all work within the United States, and ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination and complete required background screening.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with the U.S. Web Design System or another mature design system, including extending accessible, reusable components.
  • Experience incrementally modernizing legacy interfaces within .NET, ASP.NET MVC, or Razor-based applications.
  • Experience building data-intensive interfaces, such as configurable data-entry workflows, complex data tables, dashboards, or reporting tools.
  • Experience integrating interfaces with federated identity, single sign-on, multifactor authentication, or role-based access.
  • Experience improving frontend performance and reliability through monitoring, analytics, error tracking, browser compatibility testing, and automated deployment pipelines.
  • Experience supporting federal or public health applications, including familiarity with secure cloud environments, federal security and privacy requirements, or sensitive data handling.

raw.description:
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an organized and detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of a growing roofing company serving customers across California.

This role combines permit coordination, customer communication, invoicing, production scheduling, job documentation, and administrative support. You’ll work closely with project managers and field crews to keep roofing projects organized, compliant, and moving forward from signed contract through project close-out.

What You’ll Own

Permit Coordination

  • Manage the full permit process for roofing projects across California.
  • Track permit applications and follow up with local municipalities.
  • Ensure every job is fully compliant before work begins.

Customer Coordination

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for homeowners and commercial clients.
  • Answer inbound calls and respond to customer inquiries.
  • Keep customers informed throughout the production cycle.
  • Escalate issues requiring field decisions to the appropriate project manager.

Invoicing & Billing

  • Generate, send, and track invoices using QuickBooks.
  • Reconcile payments and maintain accurate records.
  • Flag outstanding balances to the appropriate team member in a timely manner.

Production Scheduling Support

  • Work alongside project managers and field crews to coordinate roofing project timelines.
  • Confirm material deliveries and job readiness.
  • Identify and flag scheduling conflicts before they affect crews on the ground.

Job & Document Management

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project records in JobNimbus.
  • Keep photos, contracts, notes, and permit documentation organized.
  • Ensure the team has a reliable single source of truth for every active project.

Administrative Operations

  • Handle day-to-day office tasks, including filing and data entry.
  • Manage internal communication and administrative needs.
  • Support the smooth operation of the California team.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience in an operations coordinator, office manager, production coordinator, or administrative coordinator role.
  • Experience in construction, roofing, or a related trade is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with JobNimbus or a comparable construction CRM for job tracking and documentation.
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks for invoicing, payment tracking, and basic financial record-keeping.
  • Experience pulling building permits or coordinating permit applications.
  • Understanding of municipal permitting in California or a comparable jurisdiction.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Confidence representing a roofing company professionally on calls with customers, city offices, and contractors.
  • Ability to manage multiple active projects simultaneously.
  • Strong prioritization, organization, and record-keeping skills with minimal supervision.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You follow through without needing reminders and take ownership of tasks until they are completed.
  • You communicate proactively when something is delayed, behind schedule, or unclear.
  • You are highly precise with permit numbers, invoice amounts, job addresses, customer names, and other project details.
  • You remain calm and organized when multiple priorities require attention at the same time.
  • You know how to triage tasks, take clear notes, and keep work moving.
  • You are comfortable coordinating across teams and time zones through phone, email, and JobNimbus.
  • You are proactive about identifying potential issues before they impact customers, crews, or project timelines.

What Success Looks Like

  • Permit applications are tracked, followed up on, and completed before work begins.
  • Customers receive timely and professional communication throughout the production cycle.
  • Invoices and payments are accurately processed and tracked.
  • Project schedules, materials, and potential conflicts are proactively coordinated.
  • JobNimbus records remain accurate, complete, and up to date.
  • Project managers and field crews have the information they need to execute jobs smoothly.
  • Administrative tasks are completed reliably without constant follow-up.

Typical Day

Your morning starts by reviewing JobNimbus for new jobs, updated project statuses, and tasks that came in overnight.

You’ll check outstanding permit applications, send required follow-up documentation to city offices, and update project records accordingly. Mid-morning often brings inbound customer calls, where you’ll answer scheduling questions, provide project updates, and escalate anything requiring a field decision to the project manager.

Before midday, you may process new invoices in QuickBooks and reconcile recent payments.

Afternoons are typically focused on production coordination, confirming crew schedules, flagging material needs, and making sure upcoming roofing projects have everything in place before work begins.

You’ll work closely with project managers and field leadership, with most coordination taking place asynchronously through phone, email, and JobNimbus notes.

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Final Selection

OVERVIEW - US ONLY

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join a contractor program in supporting a critical customer engagement. This role is ideal for an engineer who can own features end to end across a React frontend, a Node.js service layer, and a PostgreSQL data model, and deploy and operate them on Google Cloud Platform with minimal oversight. The successful candidate will work closely with the Engagement Lead and Program Manager and customer stakeholders to ensure project success from initial definition through final delivery.

Required Credentials

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production web applications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Required Qualifications

  • Backend development in Java with Spring Boot, including REST API design, Spring Data JPA or an equivalent persistence layer, and Spring Security
  • Frontend development in React, including state management and integration with backend APIs
  • Working proficiency in Node.js for building and maintaining supporting services, including REST API design and one common framework (Express, Fastify, or NestJS)
  • Ability to translate Figma mockups into production React components
  • Relational data modeling in PostgreSQL, including authoring SQL queries, joins, and schema migrations
  • Writing unit tests and maintaining test coverage as part of the development workflow, using tools such as JUnit and Mockito on the Java side
  • Deployment and operation of applications on Google Cloud Platform (for example Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage)
  • Proficiency with Git-based version control and pull request workflows

Useful Qualifications

  • TypeScript across frontend and Node.js services
  • Build tooling for Java projects (Maven or Gradle)
  • Containerization with Docker
  • CI/CD pipeline configuration (Cloud Build or GitHub Actions)
  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform
  • Google Cloud certification (Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Cloud Developer)
  • Integration and end-to-end testing experience beyond the unit level

Contractor Scope of Work Delivery Expectations

Below covers the scope of work we anticipate the contractor supporting throughout the project timeline.

Scope and Solution Expectations:

  1. Design and implement application features spanning the React frontend, the Spring Boot backend, and the PostgreSQL schema.
  2. Build React components and views from Figma mockups provided by the design team.
  3. Design and evolve the PostgreSQL data model, including authoring SQL and writing schema migrations.
  4. Build and maintain the REST API layer between the frontend and the Spring Boot services.
  5. Develop and maintain supporting Node.js services and their integration with the Spring Boot backend.
  6. Write unit tests for new and modified code as part of the standard development workflow.
  7. Deploy and configure application components on GCP, including runtime services, the managed database, and object storage.
  8. Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines covering build, test, and deployment for both the Java and Node.js components.
  9. Participate in working sessions with the engagement team and customer stakeholders to define requirements and technical approach.
  10. Produce technical documentation covering architecture, API contracts, and the data model.
Salary: $80 – $100 / hour

The International ESIA Lead will play a pivotal role in driving the strategic development and expansion of international environmental and social impact assessment (ESIA) services across Africa, within the renewables, energy, infrastructure and mining sectors. Vira Games - незалежна ігрова компанія, що спеціалізується на розробці та видавництві мобільних ігор. Наша команда - це творчий альянс, що об’єднує досвід, креативність, драйвовість і професіоналізм.

Ми запускаємо паблішинг-напрям: видання ігор сторонніх студій у GP/iOS із валідацією та масштабуванням через нашу платформу. Напрям будується з нуля — і ми шукаємо людину, яка його побудує.

Місія ролі: це роль будівничого, а не керівника готової структури.
Ви — DRI паблішинг-напряму: стратегія, deal flow, економіка угод, команда.
Перші місяці — граючий тренер: сорсинг і переговори зі студіями ви ведете особисто, спираючись на власний нетворк.
Далі — найм і розвиток команди (перший найм — Publishing Producer, за вашої участі у виборі).

Підпорядкування: Co-CEO (на етапі запуску).

Цілі на перші 12 місяців:

  • Підписаний портфель студій з активним пайплайном переговорів.

  • 2–3 тайтли, що пройшли валідацію та перебувають в активному масштабуванні.

  • Робочий greenlight-процес із чіткими критеріями.

  • Сформоване ядро команди.

Обов'язки:

  • Deal flow: сорсинг студій, воронка, переговори, підписання. Перші угоди — особисто.

  • Економіка: структура rev share, unit economics угод, прогнози окупності спільно з аналітикою.

  • Greenlight: критерії відбору тайтлів, процес валідації через платформу, рішення за етапами (тест → soft launch → масштабування).

  • Портфель: управління виданими тайтлами спільно з Producer — роадмапи, LiveOps, робота зі студіями.

  • Команда: найм Publishing Producer, надалі зростання команди разом зі зростанням портфеля.

Навички та досвід:

  • Досвід побудови паблішинг-функції з нуля або на ранній стадії — не управління готовою.

  • Власний нетворк студій і репутація на ринку: вам є кому написати вже в перший тиждень.

  • Особистий досвід ведення угод: term sheets, структури rev share, переговори з фаундерами студій.

  • Вільне володіння економікою паблішингу: eROAS, payback, когортні моделі — на рівні самостійних розрахунків.

  • Досвід у casual/mid-core на GP/iOS.

  • Англійська — B2.

Буде перевагою:

  • Досвід роботи з publishing-платформами або SDK-продуктами.

  • Досвід найму та розвитку команди.

The Position

We’re looking for an enthusiastic Junior Lecturer/Academic Owner in Human Resource Management to join our fully remote team!

This is an ideal opportunity for an early-career academic or HR professional who is passionate about people, organisations and developing future HR professionals.

In this role, you will support the development, facilitation and assessment of learning across Human Resource Management modules, including People Leadership and Governance, Talent Management, People Management, Human Resource Governance, and related HR and people management modules.

You will help students understand how effective people management contributes to organisational success, while developing their ability to apply HR principles to real workplace challenges. You will also contribute to ensuring that our curriculum remains current, practical and responsive to the changing world of work.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a forward-thinking, digitally enabled higher education environment.
  • Build your academic career within a supportive and collaborative School of Commerce team.
  • Help shape the next generation of HR and people management professionals.
  • Bring contemporary workplace and people challenges into the learning environment.
  • Develop experience in teaching, assessment, curriculum development and academic quality assurance.
  • Enjoy competitive remuneration and ongoing professional development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate engaging and interactive online learning sessions across assigned HR and people management modules.
  • Support the development and review of high-quality, outcomes-based learning content.
  • Design and contribute to assessments that promote applied learning, critical thinking and sound professional judgement.
  • Assess student performance through formative, summative and practical assessments.
  • Support learning across areas such as people management, talent management, leadership, HR governance and contemporary people practices.

  • Ensure marking, assessment and results processes meet required academic standards.

  • Engage with HR professionals and industry developments to ensure learning remains connected to contemporary workplace practice.

raw.description:
About the team

At Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group’s FinTech division, you’ll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We’re a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.

Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams.

One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow’s industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem.

About the role

This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officeroriginating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow’s ecosystem. You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization—supported by Zillow’s brand, platform, and operational scale.

This role is “remote” with restrictions. Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above Kansas. You may also elect to spend some time working at a company office. Please note that your employment is contingent upon remaining in this location; any future requests to relocate to another state are subject to Company review and approval and may be denied based upon business need.

You Will Get To:

  • Originate and manage purchase mortgage loans from application through closing while ensuring compliance with all requirements.

  • Convert company-provided purchase opportunities into funded loans through proactive follow-up and effective borrower consultation.

  • Build strong relationships with customers and, where applicable, with Zillow Preferred Agents and local partners.

  • Manage an active pipeline while meeting defined service levels, productivity metrics, and funding expectations.

  • Leverage Zillow’s CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement.

  • Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently.

  • Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication.

  • Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions.

  • Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development.

  • This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes.

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license.

  • Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test – National Component with Uniform State Content.

  • Physically located in and working remotely from Kansas.

  • Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model.

  • Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process.

  • Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly.

  • Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel).

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply if you bring transferable skills or related experience.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


For US applicants: Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.


Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

raw.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

BeOne is a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the discovery and development of innovative drug therapies for the treatment of cancer. At BeOne we believe that access to life-changing medicine sees no borders.

The Senior Manager, Global Digital & Technology System Ownership is accountable for the day-to-day ownership, operational health, lifecycle execution, and compliant management of Global Patient Safety R&D externally developed platforms and validated systems within the global R&D technology portfolio.

This role translates the GRDTS system ownership model into disciplined execution across technical configuration, platform operations, lifecycle planning, release and upgrade coordination, access management, documentation, security activities, vendor delivery, budget inputs, and inspection-ready evidence.

The Senior Manager partners with R&D business process owners, Global Technology Solutions, Information Security, Quality, vendors, Finance, Procurement, project teams, and support functions to ensure assigned platforms remain compliant, secure, reliable, supportable, and aligned with scientific and business needs.

The successful candidate brings strong regulated-systems experience specifically in Safety systems, hands-on operational leadership, structured problem solving, and the ability to coordinate global stakeholders through platform changes, incidents, competing priorities, and complex technical dependencies.

Essential Functions of the job:

System Ownership Execution & Governance

• Execute the system ownership model for Global Patient Safety’s externally developed platforms, maintaining clear accountability for business purposes, technical health, compliance posture, roadmap, support model, and lifecycle status.

• Maintain system governance routines, decision logs, ownership records, operating controls, documentation standards, and cross-functional action tracking for validated and non-validated platforms.

• Serve as the primary operational escalation point for assigned platforms, coordinating issue prioritization, risk review, lifecycle recommendations, and stakeholder alignment.

Technical Configuration, Platform Implementation, Upgrades & Integrations

• Lead and coordinate technical configuration, platform implementation, upgrade readiness, integration changes, environment preparation, testing support, release execution, and post-release stabilization for assigned platforms for Global Patient Safety such as Argus, Case Intake system, Signal Detection platform, and Safety data mart and etc.

• Ensure implementation and change plans align with Enterprise IT standards, cybersecurity requirements, validation expectations, business readiness, data and integration needs, and operational support models.

• Manage dependencies, risks, communications, cutover activities, vendor deliverables, and stabilization actions for upgrades, integrations, enhancements, and platform modernization efforts.

System Life-Cycle Management & Roadmap Execution

• Manage lifecycle activities for assigned systems, including onboarding, capability expansion, roadmap maintenance, technical debt reduction, modernization, retirement, and transition planning.

• Convert business needs, platform needs, functions, features, technical constraints, and compliance requirements into executable roadmap items and prioritized delivery plans.

• Coordinate feature and functionality additions, edits, and enhancements with business owners, technical teams, Enterprise IT, vendors, and Quality stakeholders.

Operational Excellence for Validated Systems

• Own execution and monitoring of validated-system operations, including user access workflows, role governance, audit trail review, periodic review, security checks, evidence collection, and remediation tracking.

• Ensure operating activities are consistently performed, documented, inspection-ready, and aligned with GxP, computer systems validation, 21 CFR Part 11, internal SOPs, and Quality expectations.

• Identify and implement improvements to operational controls, review cadence, exception management, metrics, and issue closure practices.

System Documentation & SOP Management

• Create, maintain, and periodically refresh system ownership artifacts, configuration records, technical operating procedures, administration and user access SOPs, support playbooks, and other system documentation.

• Ensure documentation reflects current configuration, access models, integrations, lifecycle status, change history, operating procedures, support arrangements, and inspection-readiness needs.

• Coordinate SOP creation, review, approval, training impacts, evidence readiness, and audit response activities with Quality, business process owners, and system teams.

System Security, Patch, Certificate & SSO Coordination

• Coordinate system security and maintenance activities, including patch planning, vulnerability remediation, certificate renewals, single sign-on coordination, identity and access dependencies, and risk-based prioritization.

• Partner with Enterprise IT and Information Security to plan and execute security actions in alignment with corporate policies, system criticality, business continuity needs, validation requirements, and change controls.

• Maintain visibility of security risks, exceptions, remediation owners, due dates, evidence, and closure status through appropriate governance and escalation channels.

Budget Support, AOP & Vendor Management

• Develop annual operating plan inputs for assigned platforms, including license, maintenance, upgrade, support, vendor, implementation, and lifecycle investment assumptions.

• Manage vendor operational performance, service reviews, roadmap follow-up, escalations, contract and statement-of-work inputs, renewal preparation, deliverables, and action closure.

• Partner with Finance, Procurement, Legal, business owners, and vendors to track spend, commitments, renewals, service expectations, and delivery against agreed business priorities.

Incident, Issue & Platform Problem Management

• Lead operational response for platform incidents, recurring problems, integration failures, access issues, service disruptions, security events, and vendor delivery issues within assigned scope.

• Coordinate root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, communications, service restoration, risk documentation, escalation, and status reporting.

• Convert recurring platform issues into sustainable remediation plans, roadmap items, support model improvements, operating control changes, or vendor actions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Team Leadership

• Represent assigned system ownership priorities in working sessions and governance forums with R&D functions, Enterprise IT, Information Security, Quality, Finance, Procurement, and vendors.

• Lead and coach system owners, system managers, administrators, contractors, and matrixed partners in disciplined system ownership, compliant execution, technical rigor, and reliable service delivery.

• Contribute to GRDTS portfolio transparency, prioritization, audit and inspection readiness, operational metrics, and continuous improvement of technology operating practices.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with System Owners, System Managers, or other assigned GRDTS resources responsible for platform operations, lifecycle activities, documentation, and validated-system execution.

• Coordinate matrixed technical resources, vendor partners, contractors, system administrators, and project teams supporting assigned systems and platform initiatives.

Key Capabilities:

• System ownership execution: applying accountable ownership models, governance routines, lifecycle controls, operating standards, and escalation pathways for R&D platforms and validated systems.

• Platform delivery and operations: coordinating configuration, implementation, integrations, upgrades, releases, roadmap items, technical debt actions, and operational stabilization.

• Regulated systems management: executing user access workflows, audit trail review, periodic review, SOP alignment, evidence management, remediation tracking, and inspection readiness.

• Security and resilience coordination: managing patch, certificate, SSO, vulnerability, incident, continuity, and risk activities with Enterprise IT, Information Security, Quality, and vendors.

• Vendor and financial stewardship: preparing budget inputs, monitoring spend, managing service performance, supporting renewals, and tracking vendor commitments to closure.

Key Competencies:

• Systems thinking across business processes, platform configuration, integrations, data flows, access controls, compliance requirements, and operational support models.

• Cross-functional influence and clear communication with R&D, Enterprise IT, Information Security, Quality, Finance, Procurement, Legal, vendors, and global stakeholders.

• Operational rigor, inspection-ready execution, sound judgment, structured problem solving, and the ability to convert ambiguous issues into clear actions and decisions.

• Composed incident leadership during outages, upgrades, integration disruptions, security issues, and vendor escalations.

• People leadership, coaching, prioritization, delegation, and accountability across direct, matrixed, contractor, and vendor resources.

Key Deliverables:

• Assigned-system ownership package covering accountability, governance cadence, lifecycle status, operating controls, documentation, metrics, risks, decisions, and escalations.

• System roadmap and execution plan covering business needs, functions, features, integrations, dependencies, lifecycle milestones, enhancement priorities, technical debt, and risk actions.

• Validated-system operations package covering access workflows, audit trail review, periodic review, evidence standards, SOP alignment, remediation tracking, and inspection readiness.

• System security and maintenance tracker covering patches, certificate renewals, SSO coordination, vulnerability remediation, security exceptions, owners, due dates, evidence, and closure.

• Budget and vendor management materials covering annual operating plan inputs, renewals, service reviews, vendor commitments, contract and statement-of-work inputs, escalation logs, and performance follow-up.

• Incident and problem management records, including root-cause summaries, corrective and preventive action plans, stakeholder updates, decision logs, and durable remediation actions.

Other Qualifications:

• 7+ years of professional experience in digital, technology, information systems, R&D technology, application operations, systems engineering, or related areas; pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or regulated healthcare experience strongly preferred.

• 4+ years of progressive leadership or management experience coordinating technical teams, matrixed partners, vendor resources, and cross-functional delivery across global or complex operating environments.

• Demonstrated experience owning or managing business-critical platforms, including configuration, implementation, integrations, release and upgrade planning, access workflows, documentation, operational controls, incident management, and production support.

• Strong working knowledge and hands on experience in managing safety case processing platform, case intake system, signal detection system, safety data marts and reports.

• Strong working knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, computer systems validation, change control, audit trail review, periodic review, SOP governance, inspection readiness, and regulated system operations.

• Demonstrated ability to partner with Enterprise IT, Information Security, Quality, Finance, Procurement, Legal, vendors, business process owners, and global R&D stakeholders.

• Experience with single sign-on, identity and access management, patching, certificates, vulnerability remediation, incident and problem management, vendor service management, and platform support processes.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk, operational health, roadmap tradeoffs, incident status, and investment needs to senior stakeholders.

• Proficient in project, product, and operational delivery methods such as Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Lean, ITIL, or similar approaches.

Travel:

• Some travel expected as part of assigned duties


Education Required:

• Bachelor or above

raw.description:
At R1, we’re transforming how healthcare works by combining nearly two decades of revenue cycle expertise with advanced technology, including analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration. We pair that technology with the irreplaceable expertise of our people to help hospitals, health systems and medical groups improve financial performance, simplify administrative complexity and create better experiences for patients and providers.

All Together Better defines our culture and the way we work. We’re a diverse, global team united by a shared mission to make healthcare work better for all. Across technology, operations and support functions, our people bring deep expertise, empathy and ingenuity to the work we do. Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what’s next for R1 and the future of healthcare.


About R37

R37 is R1’s AI innovation lab, building technology to transform healthcare.


Our flagship platform, Phare OS, uses AI and automation to improve critical pre-bill workflows, including authorization, utilization management, documentation and coding. By identifying and resolving issues before claims are submitted, Phare OS helps prevent denials, improve reimbursement and move revenue cycle work upstream.


What makes R37 different is the opportunity to build advanced AI at real-world scale. R1 works across 95 of the top 100 U.S. health systems, giving R37 access to the data, workflows and reach needed to make an immediate impact:

  • 180M+ claims
  • 550M+ patient encounters
  • 1.2B+ workflow actions and outcomes annually

This is startup-level ownership with enterprise-level impact. You’ll build technology that moves from idea to real healthcare environments, solving complex problems at scale and changing how healthcare works.

As our Product Engineer, you will help transform complex healthcare workflows into intuitive, AI-powered products that deliver meaningful value to users. Every day you will build full-stack applications using modern web technologies, collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to understand workflow challenges, and design user experiences that bring AI capabilities to life in simple, transparent, and trustworthy ways. To thrive in this role, you must be a strong full-stack engineer with excellent product instincts, enjoy solving customer problems end-to-end, and be passionate about leveraging AI to create impactful user experiences.

Here's what you will experience working as a Product Engineer:

  • Building and delivering AI-powered products using React, Node.js, Python, and modern full-stack development practices.
  • Partnering directly with customers, designers, and researchers to understand user needs and translate them into innovative product solutions.
  • Designing intuitive experiences that make sophisticated AI outputs and automations easy to understand and adopt.
  • Owning features end-to-end, from product ideation and technical design through deployment, iteration, and scaling.
  • Helping shape the future of AI-native healthcare products by combining strong engineering execution with a product-first mindset.

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on React development.
  • Expert proficiency in React, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, and Python.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating production-grade full-stack applications.
  • Proven ability to own projects and features from requirements gathering and design through deployment and optimization.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product, design, and customer-facing teams to deliver high-impact solutions.
  • Passion for AI-powered applications and an eagerness to incorporate AI into real-world workflows and business processes.

Bonus if you have: Visual design skills (Figma, Illustrator)


Role Leveling

We are looking for candidates at various levels, ranging from Level 2 to Staff

  • L2: Independently delivers a complete end-to-end project, owning design, implementation, and delivery of scoped work (Compensation Range for L2: $120k - $150k)
  • L3: Leads delivery of larger projects, handling increased technical complexity and ambiguity, providing light guidance to L2s on shared work (Compensation Range for L3: $140k - $220k)
  • Senior: Team Lead responsible for managing a portfolio of projects that contribute to major technical initiatives. (Compensation Range for Senior: $140k - $255k)
  • Staff: Impact at the organizational level. Responsible for leading multiple teams or multiple broad initiatives simultaneously, ensuring that high-level technical goals are met across the entire organization. (Compensation Range for Staff: $140k - $300k)

Benefits

  • Top-of-market compensation, including bonus that starts at 10%
  • Flexible PTO
  • Comprehensive health benefits
  • 401(k) matching

For this US-based position, the base pay range is $105,000.00 - $202,500.00 per year . Individual pay is determined by role, level, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.This job is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan at a target of 10.00%

We go beyond expectations in everything we do. raw.description:
Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)

Location: Remote (U.S.-based) Preference given to CA, TX and FL
Department: Engineering
Reports to: VP of Engineering
Starting Pay Range: $142k - $170k/yr

Company Overview

Work Truck Solutions is the operating system for the commercial vehicle industry. While the retail auto market is saturated with software, the $130B+ commercial truck market was operating in the dark—until we turned on the lights.
We are the only platform that connects the entire ecosystem: OEMs, upfitters, dealerships, and fleet buyers. By digitizing complex inventory data (chassis + upfits) and streamlining the supply chain, we don’t just help dealers sell trucks; we ensure American businesses get the mission-critical vehicles they need to work. We are a team of innovators, disruptors, and problem-solvers dedicated to one mission: removing the friction from the commercial vehicle industry. We are profitable, growing, and aggressively scaling our technology to remain the undisputed authority in this space.

The Role

This is a senior, hands-on remote role for someone who has built test automation programs before and wants to build the next one with AI at the center. You will own how we test our products end to end: the Playwright suite that covers our dealer software, our internal admin tools and Comvoy.com, the way tests get written and maintained, and the path from a pull request to a release we trust.
Our engineering team is moving to an agentic way of working, where much of our code is written by AI agents under human review. That only works if our tests catch what the agents get wrong, and you will be the person who makes that true. You will use AI to write, expand and maintain test coverage far faster than a team could by hand. Just as important, you know when not to test. AI makes it easy to generate thousands of tests, and 10,000 Playwright tests is far more than our application needs. You will judge every test by the value it provides and remove the ones that don’t earn their place.
You will sit on our Platform team, next to the engineers who own our cloud infrastructure, pipelines and environments, and you will work across every product team. A large part of the job is people. You will mentor our existing test engineers, pair with them, review their work and help them become strong automation engineers who build with AI every day.

Responsibilities

  • Own the test automation strategy. Decide what gets tested at which layer (unit, API, end to end) and drive automated coverage until it is the main way we know a release is safe. Define the measures that show progress, such as coverage, flake rate, run time and escaped defects, and report on them.
  • Decide what is worth testing. Set a clear bar for test value: what risk a test covers, what it costs to run and maintain, and whether a cheaper test at a lower layer would do the job. Review the suite against that bar regularly and delete tests that fall below it, including AI-generated ones.
  • Build and scale our Playwright suite. Lead the architecture of our TypeScript Playwright framework: page objects, fixtures, test data, environment handling, parallel runs and reporting.
  • Use AI to build and expand automation. Use AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code or similar) to write new tests, convert manual test cases and legacy tests, triage failures and fix flaky tests. Build the prompts, rules, skills and agent workflows that let the whole team work this way. Set the review standard for AI-generated tests so they check real behavior, not just pass.
  • Explore agentic testing. Evaluate and pilot newer approaches, such as agents that explore the application, generate test plans from requirements or repair broken locators. Bring in what works and drop what doesn’t.
  • Mentor the QA team. Coach our test engineers on automation design, Playwright and AI-assisted workflows through pairing, code review and hands-on teaching. You are measured on how much the team improves, not only on the tests you write yourself.
  • Build testing into the pipeline. Work with Platform engineers to run the right tests at the right stage of CI/CD, on short-lived test environments, with fast and reliable feedback to developers. Help us gate deployments on test results we trust.
  • Partner with developers. Help product engineers write testable code and own their own tests, including the test attributes and contracts that keep UI tests stable as the product changes.
  • Collaboration. Communicate clearly with a distributed team, raise quality risks early and work well with both technical and non-technical partners.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a very senior engineer. You have built and run test automation at scale, you have made other test engineers better, and you have already changed how you work because of AI.
  • Deep test automation experience. 7+ years in test automation or software engineering in test, including designing and owning an automation framework that a whole team used, not just contributing tests to one.
  • Expert in Playwright. Production experience with Playwright and TypeScript: fixtures, page objects, network interception, authentication state, parallel runs, tracing and tracking down flaky tests.
  • Judgment about test value. You know when not to test. You can explain why a given test is or isn’t worth keeping, and you have a record of shrinking a bloated suite while making it more useful.
  • Hands-on AI experience (required). You use AI coding agents in your daily work and can talk about that work in specifics: tests or frameworks you built with AI, prompts or agent configurations you wrote, and a time AI-generated tests went wrong and how you caught it. You are curious about where this is going and want to push it further.
  • A track record of mentoring. You have coached test engineers, including people moving from manual testing into automation, and you can point to people who grew because of you.
  • Strong coder in more than one language. You write and read code in multiple languages, including JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one backend language such as C#. You can read our codebase (a .NET backend with SvelteKit and React frontends) and understand what you are testing. You understand the JavaScript behind Playwright well enough to debug async behavior, the browser and the test runner itself. You treat test code as production code.
  • API and data testing. Experience testing REST APIs and creating and managing test data, including in SQL databases.
  • CI/CD. Experience running test suites in pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar) with a focus on speed, reliability and clear reporting.
  • Strong Git workflow. Branching, pull requests and code reviews are second nature.

Nice to Have

  • Testing in .NET (C#) with MSTest or NUnit, or frontend unit testing with Vitest.
  • Experience with SvelteKit or React applications.
  • Experience with Azure.
  • Testing LLM-powered features or building evaluations for AI output.
  • Performance, accessibility or visual regression testing.

Benefits

  • Meaningful work on industry-changing products.
  • Competitive salary and a Monday-Friday work week.
  • Excellent medical, dental, 401k, and complimentary life insurance.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays.
  • Flexible schedule (subject to manager’s discretion).

Work Truck Solutions DOES NOT sponsor H-1B visas.

raw.description:
Howmet Aerospace is searching for a Sales Territory Manager - North Central US to join our Howmet Wheel Systems (HWS) business unit. This role will be known internally as Fleet Territory Manager, North Central US.

Our customers trust us to deliver a wide range of great looking and dependable products that improve fuel economy and increase payload to address their customer’s business needs. Our Commercial Vehicle Wheel products lead the world in market innovation and truck, trailer, and bus customers.

The primary responsibility of the Fleet Territory Manager is to penetrate his / her truck fleet and dealer accounts at all levels to persuade them to specify and/or purchase ALCOA ® Wheels. Additionally, this position requires extensive knowledge and thorough understanding of the Heavy-Duty (HD) Truck, Medium Duty (MD), Transit Bus, and Trailer market. It also requires the ability to deal with travel and absences from home. Travel Requirement: Minimum 50%

Under the direction of the National Fleet Sales Manager, this position is accountable for:

  • Developing and nurturing primarily steel wheel fleets into Howmet Aerospace aluminum fleets by establishing credible relationships and providing ROI based solutions in the following states: WA, OR, AK, ID, MT, WY, UT, CO, ND, SD, NE, MN, IA, MO, WI, IL, MI and IN. The Fleet Territory Manager (FTM) is expected to execute Howmet Aerospace’s value-based sales model to promote Howmet Wheel Systems’ value proposition aligning it with key fleet and dealer customers to optimize mutual financial success. In addition to growth, the position is responsible for developing long term relationships with existing Howmet Wheel fleets. The Fleet Territory Manager will have 100% responsibility for 400 to 700 fleets in their respective territories. Total potential among these fleets is estimated at 700,000 to 900,000 wheels/yr. Incumbent is expected to organize an effective sales call pattern and meet/exceed monthly sales metrics determined by the National Sales Manager.
  • Sales and field service operations are conducted by the Fleet Territory Managers using their home or company office as their base. The Incumbent can reside anywhere within the Territory, Remote Position, or Hybrid (Cleveland business unit headquarters). Their territories are extremely large, and they must be strongly self-motivated since they have limited personal contact with regional sales management or business unit management.
  • The incumbent participates in trade/state association meetings, conventions and shows and represents HWS in trade associations (i.e., TMC, NPTC) and fleet/dealer events.
  • As conditions are constantly changing within HWS and in the marketplace, the incumbent must effectively apply knowledge and skill in creating an acceptable balance of the customer needs and the company's current capabilities.
  • Increase HWS’s penetration and share of aluminum wheels among assigned fleets through effective specification selling and technical service at key fleets and dealers. Comprehensive utilization of a CRM database and call reporting is mandatory.
  • Maintaining significant HWS fleets and retaining recently won business are crucial success factors for the FTM.
  • Monthly metrics will be established and tracked. The FTM is expected to meet or exceed the monthly, quarterly and/or annual targets for these metrics. The metrics are target accounts, growth pipeline, Salesforce.com CRM usage, losses, incremental growth revenue (share, penetration, mix), T&E budget and others. The sales incentive plan may include a combination of any of these metrics depending on the overall goals of the business for that year.

Environment, Health & Safety Requirements:

Sales and field service operations are conducted by the FTM using their home or company office as their base. Fleets and dealers are scattered across a large geography and require a candidate that is strongly self-motivated with the ability to operate autonomously.

  • Key contacts are with management, finance, marketing, purchasing, product safety, maintenance and technical representatives of major fleets, truck/trailer dealers and industry stakeholders. Internal contacts include all disciplines of HWS.
  • The incumbent reports to the National Fleet Sales Manager
  • Incumbent recognizes that accident prevention is equal to quality, production, delivery, and cost control and accepts the responsibility to work safety while promoting safety conscious among fellow employees.
  • This position requires an associate's degree from an accredited institution
  • 3-5 years of sales experience in a related field
  • Must hold a valid Driver’s License and maintain an acceptable driving record in order to carry out the responsibilities of the role
  • Possess a US Passport or be eligible to obtain such
  • This position is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) which requires U.S. person status. ITAR defines U.S. person as an U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Management/Business or Engineering or equivalent from an accredited institution
  • Strong communications, interpersonal, leadership, presentation and computer skills Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, as well as experience in using Salesforce CRM highly desirable
  • Knowledge of commercial vehicle industry. Trade organization affiliations and an established network preferred.
  • The incumbent must be able to develop a sales plan for strategic fleets of responsibility and assure proper execution of such a plan
  • The ability to establish a close relationship with major customers/fleets/dealers and efficiently manage his/her accounts is mandatory
  • The incumbent should also have excellent commercial and customer relations skills as this is a key part of properly understanding, marketing and selling wheels
  • The incumbent must also have demonstrated the ability to deal effectively with varying circumstances
