raw.description:
Who We Are:

On Location is a global leader in premium experiential hospitality, offering ticketing, curated guest experiences, live event production and travel management across sports, entertainment, fashion and culture. On Location provides unrivaled access for corporate clients and fans looking for official, immersive experiences at marquee events, including the Olympic and Paralympic Games, FIFA World Cup 2026, Super Bowl, NCAA Final Four, and more. An official partner and/or service provider to over 150 iconic rights holders, such as the IOC (the Milano Cortina 2026 and Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games), FIFA, NFL, NCAA, UFC, WWE, and PGA of America, the company also owns and operates a number of its own unique experiences. On Location is a subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), a premium sports and entertainment company.TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

The Senior Manager, Event Operations & Planning for On Location, Combat Sports team will play a central role in working with more than 10 functional areas across On Location that will sell, deliver, and innovate Hospitality and VIP Experience programs alongside UFC, WWE, Zuffa Boxing, and TKO.


Main responsibilities will include:

  • Collecting and evaluating functional area project deadlines, milestones and deliverables.
  • Measuring the project health and summarizing project progress according to milestones set at the Rights holder partner level, or by the On Location functional areas. Making sure that all parties are on track with project requirements, deadlines, and schedules.
  • Identifying key areas of risk or delay that require additional focus or escalation to executive leadership to ensure dependent milestones are not impacted.
  • Serve as a client-facing team member, required to coordinate meetings, reporting, and project deliverables with our Partners and internally.
  • Preparing status reports by gathering, analyzing, and summarizing relevant information.
  • Establishing & maintaining effective project communication plans and ensuring their execution.
  • Facilitating change requests to ensure that all parties are informed of the impacts (schedule, partner, financial).
  • Serving as a central hub of information and support for the entire team so internal and external communication along with relationship building is crucial to the success of the role.
  • Supporting special strategic growth initiatives within the Combat team from creation to completion by working with internal stakeholders and external clients to define that concept and create a process to bring it to fruition. This includes setting and managing client expectations, developing a detailed project plan, defining the scope of the project and assigning team members to specific tasks.
  • Building, managing and training project management systems and new tools required to work effectively.
  • Accelerating alignment across teams, integrating different functions, defining, and driving better processes, and coaching and aligning teams and leaders to achieve their desired efficiency.
  • Establishing operational accountability (e.g., checklists, quality assurance tests) for the Combat team and share best practices across event teams.
  • Ensuring teams are maintaining best practices with data across systems to ensure that when we bring it all together, it results in the correct information available to the correct teams.
  • Working with people with different styles, and ability to navigate and endure learning situations where interactions and outcomes do not go as planned.

In order to build and maintain a dynamic team mentality, a planning & coordination manager must be able to keep open and honest communication, form working relationships and motivate anyone who needs it.


Monitor Project Progress and Set Deadlines

Organization and follow-through are a big part of a planning & coordination manager’s job. From creating an accurate timeline of project completion to ensuring tasks are finished within the confines of the assignment, this manager must remain aware of how the project is progressing.

The planning and coordination manager also anticipates delays that may occur on the client side and apprises the team of any changes in the client’s needs.

Solve Issues That Arise

During every project, issues arise that need to be solved. The planning & coordination manager is the first person who clients and team members turn to when something goes wrong, so it is in these professionals’ best interest to anticipate any potential hiccups before they happen. Adaptability and problem solving are key to keeping control of a project.


You Have These:

Planning & Coordination Manager Requirements:

  • A bachelor’s degree or master's degree in Event or Project Management.
  • Proven experience in event operations, event product building, project management & project management tools.
  • Problem solving, creative solutions and strong communication are all essential.
  • Forward thinker, strong planning skills. Ability to look ahead at possible scenarios to manage different outcomes and prepare the project team members accordingly.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, across multiple time zones, with the ability to prioritize projects and deliverables as demands shift.
  • Ability to distill complex projects in a simple and understandable method requires training experience.
  • Ability to lead project teams of various sizes and see them through to completion.
  • Strong understanding of formal project management methodologies.
  • Experience as a large-scope project manager.
  • Able to complete projects in a timely manner.
  • Understanding of Project Management Systems; Airtable, Smartsheet.
  • Excellent PowerPoint capabilities.

We’d like you to have:

  • Event Management experience.
  • Internal & External client relations experience.

Planning & Coordination Skills

Because these manager responsibilities are abundant, a broad range of skills is helpful in propelling them through the process, including:

  • Accountability
  • Adaptability
  • Budget Management
  • Clear Communication
  • Creativity
  • Decisiveness
  • Delegation
  • Forecasting
  • Leadership
  • Management
  • Organization
  • Problem Solving
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Stress Management

Travel:

Occasional domestic travel to On Location offices could be required.


Per local requirements and in the interest of transparency, the hourly rate shown below reflects the prevalent current hiring range for this position. Hiring pay rates are based on a number of factors, including location and may vary depending on job-related qualifications, knowledge, skills and experience. The company strives to provide locally competitive rewards packages, which include base rate along with, as applicable, short- and long-term incentives, growth and developmental opportunities, and robust benefits, such as health care, retirement, vacation and other paid time off, and additional offerings.

Job Description

Job Description:


We are seeking a Growth and Improvement minded Regional Medical Scientific Director | Cardiopulmonary & Pulmonary Hypertension that can help drive our Strategic Operating Priorities.


  • Invent | Pursue the Most Promising Internal and External Science to Address Significant Unmet Medical Needs
  • Execute | Prioritize Resources Behind Our Key Growth Drivers (Oncology, Vaccines, Select Specialty Areas, Animal Health) While Optimizing Our Base Business)
  • Adapt | Develop Our People, Culture and Business Model to Evolve with a Dynamic Landscape
  • Diverse Talent | We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment with supporting leadership behaviors because having a high-performing, engaged workforce is critical to our ability to deliver innovative solutions to patients and customers around the world
  • Values and Standards | Our Steadfast Commitment to Our Values and Standards will Continue to Guide Us as We Take on New Challenges and Will Always be Fundamental to Our Success – They are a Competitive Advantage for Us

Location | Territory:


  • Central Plains US, with the successful candidate residing within Missouri, Kansas, Arkansas, Nebraska, or Iowa. The specific geographic territory will be defined based on business needs. Candidates must reside within the defined territory.

Summary, Focus And Purpose:


The Regional Medical Scientific Director | Cardiopulmonary & Pulmonary Hypertension is a credentialed (i.e., MD, PhD, PharmD or APP) therapeutic and disease area expert in Pulmonary Hypertension who engages in both scientific exchange and research support, when requested, with external scientific leaders and investigators in the medical and scientific community. Regional Medical Scientific Directors provide Scientific Leaders (SLs) balanced, factual, scientific information about non-product areas of interest to our Company and responds to scientific questions from SLs, including questions about our Company products and our Company data.


You are responsible for facilitating and developing peer-level relationships with scientific leaders in the external medical/scientific community including those investigators who have potential interest in participating in our Company research studies. This role requires you to provide support for data generation activities including our Company sponsored trials and our Company Independent Investigator Study Programs as prioritized and requested by our Research Development Division leadership.

Key Functions:


  • Work Independently and as a Team member with Integrity | Precision | Accomplishment | Motivational Ambition | Respect | Inclusion.
  • Identify, establish and manage collaborative professional relationships with national, regional and clinical practice scientific leaders (SLs) and investigators to identify and address scientific needs and to ensure access to medical and scientific information on areas of therapeutic interest and our Company's data or products in the Southeast US region.
  • Conduct peer-level scientific discussions and maintain a reliable presence to ensure our Scientific Leaders (SLs) have a Research & Development Division/Medical Affairs contact within our Company.
  • Engage in proactive non-product discussions regarding scientific issues (e.g., disease states, diagnosis, epidemiology, unmet medical need, and population health, etc.) that are intended to enhance scientific discussions or inform/guide our Research & Development Division, Global Medical Affairs & Human Health strategy or our Research & Development Division's programs.
  • Facilitate appropriate scientific exchange of information with SLs, including integration of scientific knowledge with actionable insights to inform our Research & Development Division and Human Health strategies.
  • Communicate external stakeholder opinions, insights and feedback on new data, clinical trends and the evolving medical landscape to Medical Affairs HQ teams to enhance scientific understanding and inform internal strategies.
  • Represent our Research & Development Division at scientific meetings and congresses and contribute to our Research & Development Division's debriefs, insight discussions and post congress reports.
  • Support data generation activities when requested by our Research & Development Division's leadership, including our Company's Investigator Study Program (ISP), by acting as the primary liaison to investigators interested in developing and completing investigative oriented research.
  • When requested by our Research & Develop leadership, work to identify potential investigators for consideration of participation in phase II-IV clinical development programs and provide scientific support for our Research & Development Division's sponsored trials.
  • Provide in-depth scientific support to Health Systems Teams.
  • Demonstrate and maintain in-depth knowledge of the assigned disease and therapeutic area(s) through educational efforts, including attendance at relevant conferences, scientific workshops, and review of key journals.
  • Fully comply with all company policies and applicable laws, regulations, and ethical standards.
  • Desire to contribute to an environment of belonging, engagement, equity, and empowerment by: Working to transform the environment, culture, and business landscape | Leveraging diversity and inclusion to increase competitive advantage, per global diversity and inclusion strategy | Ensuring accountability to drive an inclusive culture | Strengthening the foundational elements of diversity.
  • Consistent adherence to field and corporate policies and Global Medical Scientific Affairs (GMSA) strategy, including field standard operating procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines, and administrative/operational responsibilities.

Education:


  • M.D., Ph.D. Pharm.D. or APP that is relevant to the Pulmonary Hypertension area are requirements of the position.

Experience | Skills

Required Qualifications:


  • Three years in the biotech/pharmaceutical or healthcare environment.
  • Three years clinical and/or research (beyond that obtained in the terminal degree program) in the Cardiovascular & Pulmonary therapeutic areas and demonstrated scientific excellence in the therapeutic areas or five years of Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL) in a relevant therapeutic areas and demonstration of scientific excellence in the therapeutic areas.
  • Principled interpersonal, communication, networking, and presentation skills.
  • Deep therapeutic competency | Maintaining new and updated trends and new information in the Cardiovascular & Pulmonary/translational science areas.
  • Network and partner with important external customers, including scientific leaders, investigators, clinical practice leaders and academic affiliated institutions, including treatment guideline members.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Recognition for scientific excellence in the Cardiovascular & Pulmonary therapeutic areas as demonstrated by sustained contributions to the therapeutic areas via strong clinical, academic and/or translational/basic science research experience in the disease area(s) of interest.
  • Clinical therapeutic area practice and owner of independent research and publication in the relevant therapeutic area space is highly desirable (i.e., experience in late stage clinical research as an investigator or key study personnel conducting outcomes research, company sponsored trials, or investigator-initiated trials).
  • Five years of prior pharmaceutical industry experience (Medical Scientific Liaison or other clinical, medical or research related position) in the relevant TA/disease state.
  • Prior working experience within the given geography and established relationships with relevant therapeutic area stakeholders.
  • Demonstrable effective leadership skills (by example and through accomplishments), and the ability to step forward to handle challenges within scope of authority.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Consolidate and understand complex data sets, plan and/or execute data analyses, summarize, or synthesize data and objectively interpret results.
  • Knowledge of national and society treatment guidelines, clinical research processes, FDA regulations, and OIG, HIPAA and other ethical guidelines, laws, and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry and its external stakeholder environment.
  • Organize, prioritize, and work effectively in a constantly changing environment.

Travel


  • Up to 50% travel, including overnight.

Advisory Board Development, Advisory Board Development, Biopharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Cardiovascular and Metabolic Disease (CVMD), Clinical Sciences, Data Generation, Decision Making, External Collaboration, Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS), Leadership Theories, Medical Sciences, Medical Studies, Pharmaceutical Medical Affairs, Pharmaceutical Research, Pharmacoeconomics, Population Health Management, Professional Integrity, Professional Networking, Research Designs, Research Development, Research Management, Research Reporting, Scientific Communications, Scientific Literacy {+ 9 more}

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role


We are looking for a Senior Readiness Designer to elevate how the Agentforce & Data 360 Customer Success organization tells its story — internally, with executives, and with customers.

You will turn complex customer, product, technical, and business information into clear, compelling, and visually exceptional stories that showcase our strategy, progress, customer impact, and opportunities. Working closely with Customer Success leadership and cross-functional partners, you will ensure the organization is continuously ready for its most important moments — from


Playbooks, and MBRs to executive reviews, customer conversations, events, and strategic presentations.


  • Own executive presentation design and storytelling for Agentforce & Data 360 CS across MBRs, Pulse, leadership reviews, customer conversations, events, and other high-visibility moments.
  • Transform complex information into clear narratives — translating customer insights, technical concepts, business results, data, and strategy into stories that executives and customers can quickly understand and act on.
  • Partner directly with senior leaders to understand the audience, message, and desired outcome, and recommend the strongest way to tell the story.
  • Drive end-to-end content readiness for key organizational moments — from gathering inputs and shaping the storyline through design, refinement, and final delivery.
  • Create a consistent visual and storytelling system across the org so our communications feel connected, recognizable, and representative.
  • Build scalable templates and frameworks for recurring communications such as Pulse, MBRs, executive updates, customer stories, and strategic reviews.
  • Bring customer impact to life — showing what customers are accomplishing with Agentforce and Data 360, and the role CS plays in those outcomes.
  • Partner cross-functionally with CS, Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and other teams to gather inputs and develop cohesive stories.
  • Support key organizational and brand moments, including internal identity, major launches, events, and special initiatives.
  • Explore new creative and AI-enabled approaches — including Agentforce, Slack AI, and other internal tooling — to improve quality, consistency, and speed of content development.

  • 8+ years in presentation design, visual storytelling, communications design, or a comparable discipline.
  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual storytelling and executive-grade presentation design.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn complex or technical information into simple, compelling narratives for senior audiences.
  • Direct experience creating high-visibility presentations for executives, customers, or other senior audiences.
  • Strong command of Google Slides, PowerPoint, Figma, and/or Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Strong understanding of information hierarchy, layout, typography, data visualization, and brand systems.
  • Proven ability to work directly with senior leaders and navigate fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • * Strong business judgment — understands the "why" behind the content, not just how it should look.
  • * Highly collaborative, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning work end-to-end.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Please note: This role is contingent upon a contract award. While it is not an immediate opening, we are actively conducting interviews and extending offers in anticipation of the award.


The Work

At ICF our Digital Modernization Division is an information technology and management consulting organization that delivers integrated, strategic solutions to federal clients. We bring expertise in cloud, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, data modernization, and digital transformation to support mission-critical government programs.

Join a team accelerating the modernization of a large federal agency's enterprise data and analytics ecosystem. This cloud-based platform provides data storage, analytics, governance, and AI/ML capabilities that enable thousands of users to transform data into actionable insights. As demand continues to grow, the team is focused on migrating legacy workloads, streamlining onboarding and support, expanding platform capabilities, and helping organizations across the enterprise adopt modern data and AI solutions at scale.

The Product Owner owns contractor-side backlog readiness for an assigned delivery domain and ensures approved needs are translated into features, user stories, requirements, and testable acceptance criteria before refinement. Leads discovery, stakeholder clarification, backlog grooming, dependency identification, decision tracking, and sprint-ready story preparation with the Functional Lead and Agile Delivery Manager. Supports the Senior Product Manager and VA Product Owner but does not replace Government authority for priority, sequencing, approval, or acceptance.

Job Location: Remote, however, strong preference for candidates who live in the Washington DC Metro Area. There will be occasional onsite meetings on the client site in Washington, DC.


*If you accept this position, you should note that ICF does monitor employee work locations, blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses, and prohibits personal VPN connections.

What You Will Do:

  • Owns contractor-side backlog readiness for an assigned delivery domain and ensures approved needs are translated into features, user stories, requirements, and testable acceptance criteria before refinement.
  • Leads discovery, stakeholder clarification, backlog grooming, dependency identification, decision tracking, and sprint-ready story preparation with the Functional Lead and Agile Delivery Manager.
  • Supports the Senior Product Manager and VA Product Owner but does not replace Government authority for priority, sequencing, approval, or acceptance.
  • Apply Agile product management, requirements analysis, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog refinement, stakeholder facilitation, domain discovery, and dependency management to support role delivery.
  • Collaborate with relevant product, engineering, security, governance, quality, and customer-facing stakeholders as required by the role.
  • Document work products, decisions, risks, and delivery evidence to support traceability and continuous improvement.

Basic Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship is required due to federal contract requirements.
  • Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S.
  • Candidate must have lived in the U.S. for three (3) full years out of the last five (5) years.
  • Bachelor's degree in Product Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, or related field; or a high school diploma with four (4) additional years of relevant experience in lieu of a bachelor's degree.
  • Minimum 6 years of relevant experience aligned to the responsibilities of this role.
  • Master's degree may substitute for two (2) years of relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience serving as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, Business Analyst, Solutions Analyst, or similar role supporting cloud, data, analytics, AI/ML, or enterprise platform modernization initiatives.
  • Experience translating complex business, platform, architecture, governance, and operational requirements into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and sprint-ready backlog items.
  • Experience facilitating discovery sessions, requirements workshops, backlog refinement, stakeholder alignment, dependency management, and release planning activities.
  • Strong understanding of modern cloud data platform architectures, Lakehouse concepts, data engineering workflows, data governance practices, and enterprise analytics ecosystems.
  • Experience working with Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Azure Data Factory, Azure Machine Learning, Power BI, or comparable cloud-based analytics and AI platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts including predictive analytics, machine learning lifecycle management, MLOps, NLP, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), generative AI, and responsible AI principles.
  • Experience supporting enterprise data warehouse modernization, cloud migration, analytics enablement, self-service analytics platforms, or data product delivery initiatives.
  • Experience collaborating closely with Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Architects, Security teams, Governance teams, and Product Managers to define and prioritize technology solutions.
  • Experience managing technical dependencies, architectural decisions, platform capabilities, non-functional requirements, and cross-team delivery coordination.
  • Experience defining and validating functional requirements, technical requirements, operational readiness criteria, and testable acceptance criteria for platform, data, analytics, and AI solutions.
  • Familiarity with enterprise data governance concepts including metadata management, data quality, data stewardship, lineage, Collibra EDC, Immuta, Unity Catalog, or comparable governance capabilities.
  • Experience utilizing Agile delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Miro, or similar platforms.
  • Experience developing roadmaps, release plans, backlog priorities, and delivery metrics in Agile, Scrum, or SAFe environments.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, architectural tradeoffs, and platform capabilities to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting Federal government, healthcare, or other highly regulated environments preferred.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or cross-functional technology delivery teams.

Professional Skills:

  • Highly effective analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities.
  • Collaborative approach with a commitment to quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

raw.description:
Bouw mee aan de schadebehandeling van de toekomst

Insify zoekt een Claim Handler die zakelijke schades en AOV-dossiers behandelt én meebouwt aan hoe wij dat doen. Je krijgt een eigen mandaat, een klein team en een directe lijn naar onze verzekeraars. En de ruimte om het beter te doen dan je het gewend bent.

Jouw rol

Je bent goed in je vak. Je weet hoe je een dossier snel doorgrondt, wanneer een expert nodig is en hoe je een beslissing uitlegt aan een klant die net een vervelende dag heeft. Wat je waarschijnlijk mist, is invloed op hoe dat werk georganiseerd is: de systemen, de processen, de goede ideeën die blijven liggen.

Bij Insify verandert dat. Je behandelt schades op het gebied van bedrijfsaansprakelijkheid, beroepsaansprakelijkheid en inventaris en goederen. Daarnaast doe je de intakes van klanten die arbeidsongeschikt raken en behandel je bezwaren op AOV-claims. Je doet dit in een klein, scherp team, als gevolmachtigde van grote verzekeraars en herverzekeraars. Dat betekent een duidelijk eigen mandaat vanaf dag één en rechtstreeks contact met de risicodragers, zonder tussenlagen.

Je krijgt snel een compleet beeld, ook op afstand, en je weet wanneer een zaak externe expertise nodig heeft en wanneer niet. Je onderbouwt je beslissingen goed, richting klant én verzekeraar. En binnen je mandaat bepaal je zelf hoe je werkt: geen bureaucratie, wel jouw inzicht en de vrijheid om ernaar te handelen.

Het mooiste deel van deze rol: je behandelt niet alleen schades, je helpt het proces zelf opnieuw vormgeven. Wij zetten technologie en AI in om het repetitieve werk uit je dag te halen, zodat jij je tijd kunt besteden aan de zaken waar een mens echt het verschil maakt. Jij bepaalt mee wat we automatiseren, wat we juist niet automatiseren en hoe we onze fraudedetectie scherper maken. Je bouwt dus mee aan de oplossing, in plaats van die bij een ander team neer te leggen.

Onze AOV-schadebehandeling brengen we op dit moment in eigen huis. Heb je ervaring met AOV, dan speel je daarin een sleutelrol. Kom je uit de zakelijke schade en ben je nieuwsgierig naar AOV, dan leiden we je erin op.

Dit doe je als Claim Handler bij Insify

  • Intake, behandeling en afwikkeling van zakelijke schades (aansprakelijkheid, inventaris en goederen)
  • Intakes van klanten die arbeidsongeschikt raken, en behandeling van bezwaren op AOV-claims
  • Contact met experts, advocaten en andere verzekeraars
  • Rechtstreeks schakelen met onze verzekeraars en herverzekeraars
  • Klanten te woord staan, ondersteunen en adviseren, ook als het nieuws niet leuk is
  • Andere teams binnen Insify scherper maken met wat jij in dossiers ziet: van product tot acceptatie
  • Meebouwen aan de toekomst van schadebehandeling: automatisering van repetitief werk, slimme inzet van AI en scherpere fraudedetectie

Wie jij bent

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met de behandeling van zakelijke schades
  • Ervaring met AOV-claims is een pre, nieuwsgierigheid ernaar is een must
  • Je hebt Wft Basis; Wft Schade zakelijk (en particulier) is een pre
  • Je communiceert helder in het Nederlands en het Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk. We werken met een internationaal team, dus Engels gebruik je dagelijks
  • Je bent kritisch en analytisch, en je durft een beslissing te nemen en die uit te leggen
  • Je bent proactief, oplossingsgericht en pragmatisch, en je werkt efficiënt en nauwkeurig
  • Je ziet een proces dat beter kan en wilt het zelf veranderen

Wat wij bieden:

  • Een salaris afhankelijk van je ervaring
  • Een echt mandaat en directe invloed op hoe onze schadebehandeling eruitziet
  • Een klein team met korte lijnen; je rapporteert aan onze VP Claims
  • Hybride werken vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam
  • Ruimte voor opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Wft Schade of AOV-verdieping) en groei met het bedrijf mee
  • Insify Pensioenplan met 6% werkgeversbijdrage
  • Reiskostenvergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer
  • 25 vakantiedagen per jaar, plus 24 december als die op een doordeweekse dag valt
  • Tot 4 weken per jaar remote werken
  • €50 Alleo-budget per maand, te besteden aan wat jij wilt – sporten, eten, whatever
  • Maandelijkse borrels, elk kwartaal een offsite, lunch-and-learns, en al het andere leuks dat erbij hoort als een team samen wint
  • Een MacBook

Over Insify

Zakelijke verzekeringen moeten anders. Insify is ontstaan uit onze frustratie met hoe traditionele verzekeraars werken: traag, omslachtig en onpersoonlijk. Wij maken verzekeren voor ondernemers simpel, snel en eerlijk. Van het moment dat iemand klant wordt tot de laatste stap van een claim.

We zijn een insurtech en gevolmachtigd agent met een eigen platform, actief in Nederland, Frankrijk, Duitsland, Ierland en Zweden. Met een team van rond de 70 mensen verzekeren we ondernemers en zzp'ers met onder meer aansprakelijkheids-, inventaris- en AOV-verzekeringen. Achter ons staan investeerders als Accel, Munich Re Ventures en Evli Growth Partners, en we werken samen met gerenommeerde verzekeraars en herverzekeraars als risicodrager.

Technologie en data zitten in ons DNA, maar schade is het moment waarop het er voor een klant echt op aankomt. Daarom bouwen we onze schadebehandeling zelf op, met mensen die weten hoe het beter kan. Jij dus.

Solliciteren

Herken je jezelf hierin? Stuur ons je cv of LinkedIn-profiel en een paar regels over waarom deze rol bij je past. Geen motivatiebrief van drie pagina's nodig.

VP of Enterprise SalesWhat You Can Expect

What You Can Expect

As Enterprise Sales Manager, you will own the number for a team of Account Executives focused on Zoom's largest and most strategic prospects, setting the operating rhythm that makes results predictable quarter over quarter. Day to day, you will coach deals at every stage, from early qualification through late-stage executive alignment and procurement navigation, while building the playbooks and cadences that multiply your team's effectiveness. You will partner closely with SDRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Sales Ops, and Customer Success to sharpen how the team generates and converts pipeline. Candidates without prior formal people-management titles but with a strong enterprise sales track record and a natural instinct for coaching others are encouraged to apply.


About the Team

Zoom's UpMarket Sales team drives growth by connecting mid-to-large enterprises with Zoom Workplace, Zoom Contact Center, and Zoom's broader communications platform. The team plays a central role in expanding Zoom's footprint across complex, high-value accounts, working in close partnership with Solutions Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver measurable outcomes. Their results directly shape how Zoom deepens relationships with some of its most strategically important customers.


Responsibilities

  • Lead enterprise deal strategy across the team: coach AEs on account planning, multi-threading, and buying committee mapping, applying MEDDPICC or equivalent qualification frameworks to pressure-test pain, decision process, and competition.
  • Drive hands-on involvement in late-stage deals, including executive alignment, mutual action plans, pricing and negotiation, and navigation of procurement, legal, and security reviews.
  • Set pipeline targets by rep and build repeatable outbound and account-based plays with SDRs, Marketing, and Solutions Engineering, using signal-driven prioritization to focus the team where it matters most.
  • Inspect pipeline quality weekly, holding the team accountable to coverage goals, stage hygiene, next steps, close dates, and conversion metrics across each stage.
  • Own and call the team forecast with confidence each week, backed by deal-level evidence and current CRM data.
  • Run a disciplined operating cadence including weekly 1:1s, pipeline and forecast reviews, deal reviews, and quarterly business reviews.
  • Coach AEs through live deal work, call reviews, and role plays, converting individual wins into scalable team playbooks and raising the collective bar for ownership.
  • Partner on hiring, onboarding, and ramp for new AEs, setting a high bar for performance and delivering direct, timely feedback.
  • Collaborate with Sales Ops, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to reduce friction for the team and customers, and bring field insights on wins, losses, and competitive dynamics back to leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying mid-market or enterprise B2B SaaS sales with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding targets, including complex, multi-stakeholder deals with long cycles and six-figure ACVs.
  • Deep enterprise deal strategy experience: you can articulate exactly why deals were won or lost and have coached others through comparable complexity.
  • Operational rigor with pipeline management, CRM hygiene, and forecasting: you know your numbers and forecast within a tight margin of where you land.
  • Demonstrated coaching ability through informal mentorship, rep onboarding, or deal strategy leadership, with a genuine investment in making others better.
  • Clear, direct communication style that earns credibility with VP- and C-level buyers and holds a team accountable to high standards.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the pace of a high-growth environment, with a self-directed ownership mindset.
  • Familiarity with enterprise qualification frameworks such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message; experience selling to GTM, RevOps, or data-driven buyers is a plus.

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$200,700.00

Maximum:

$447,900.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

At Zoom, we offer a window of at least 5 days for you to apply because we believe in giving you every opportunity. Below is the potential closing date, just in case you want to mark it on your calendar. We look forward to receiving your application!

Anticipated Position Close Date:

10/16/26

Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learnfor more information.


About Us
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Our Commitment

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.

Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.

This position requires a deep understanding of the unique military resale channel, strong relationship-building capabilities, and a proven track record of driving CPG brand visibility and volume growth.

JOB SUMMARY

The Sr. Customer Development Manager for the Military Business is responsible for maximizing sales volume, net revenue, and category share for the Link Snacks portfolio of products within the military channel. This individual will manage direct relationships with military/government buyers, oversee broker networks, and execute joint business plans to drive maximum distribution and promotional effectiveness.

The ideal candidate will live in the Dallas area but can manage remotely with quarterly travel to market.

  • Own and manage the customer relationship with DeCA, AAFES, NEXCOM, MCX, CGX, and broker partners to unlock new distribution placements and optimize product shelf presentation.

  • Understand customer strategy and align to annual business plans that meet growth expectations.
  • Develop 1–3-year strategic customer plans by segment.
  • Provide transparent and timely communication to internal team members and customers/brokers.
  • Develop plans for channel-specific business opportunities focused on expanding Link Snacks’ in-store presence.
  • Responsible for analyzing customer data and developing an action plan to achieve sales goals.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Demand Planning, RGM, Sales Strategy) in creating both short- and long-term category and channel strategies.
  • Create and present information compellingly and persuasively.
  • Effectively build relationships throughout customer organizations and at various levels internally at Link Snacks, including Executive Management, Operations, Supply Planning, Accounting, and Marketing.
  • Manage deduction and AR issues on all applicable accounts.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

At Mission Underwriters, we provide the capital, issuing paper, and reinsurance access you need to launch your own Program Administrator (PA) business quickly and efficiently. We offer non-recourse capital for qualified underwriters, giving you a manageable risk profile with potential equity upside. By taking care of administrative complexities like compliance, risk management, accounting, and HR, we free you to focus on what you do best underwriting and distribution. Our turnkey platform gets you into the market in just a few months, minimizing disruption to your key relationships. With access to our network of highly rated issuing carriers and reinsurance partners, you can secure coverage with less stress and uncertainty. Built from the ground up, our purpose-driven technology simplifies workflows, enhances responsiveness, and eliminates the burden of outdated legacy systems.

What We Offer:

  • Remote First Work Environment (US Based)
  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401K, 401K Match
  • Life and Disability Benefits
  • Unaccrued Paid Time Off
  • 11 Paid Holidays
  • Employee Discounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Educational Assistance Program
  • Employee Referral Program

Purpose:

The Delivery Manager is responsible for coordinating and managing the successful delivery of projects, products, and technology initiatives. This role partners with cross-functional teams and external vendors to ensure initiatives are completed on time, in scope, and with high quality.

The Delivery Manager maintains department Roadmap, dependencies, identifies delivery risks, and provides clear progress updates to stakeholders. This individual serves as a key point of coordination among technology, operations, business partners, clients, and vendors throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Essential Duties/Functions:

  • Manage the day-to-day delivery of assigned products, services, and technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with established timelines, scope, and quality expectations.
  • Coordinate activities across technology, operations, business, vendor, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Facilitate project meetings, document decisions, and track deliverables, action items, risks, and issues through completion.
  • Proactively identify delivery risks, resource constraints, competing priorities, and potential delays.
  • Develop mitigation plans and escalate significant delivery concerns to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and delivery expectations.
  • Develop and refine processes to create more efficient and repeatable project delivery.
  • Monitor resource utilization, identifying and communicating potential variances.
  • Support vendor relationships by tracking deliverables, service commitments, contractual obligations, and performance expectations.
  • Participate in vendor performance reviews and document opportunities for service, quality, and delivery improvement.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, clients, business partners, and vendors.
  • Provide regular delivery updates, dashboards, and performance reports to leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Track delivery metrics and key performance indicators, including schedule performance, quality, risks, issues, and vendor performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, operational efficiency, communication, documentation, and stakeholder visibility.
  • Support the implementation of standardized delivery practices, tools, templates, and reporting processes.
  • Ensure project documentation is accurate, current, organized, and accessible to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Ensure assigned delivery activities comply with applicable regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, company policies, and industry standards.
  • Perform other duties and participate in special projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in delivery management, project management, program coordination, technology delivery, vendor management, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects or workstreams with competing timelines and priorities.
  • Experience developing and maintaining project plans, schedules, status reports, risk logs, and delivery documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and move deliverables forward without direct authority.
  • Experience identifying project risks, resolving delivery issues, and escalating concerns appropriately.
  • Working knowledge of project delivery methodologies, tools, and best practices.
  • ·Ability to travel up to 20% of the year.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience within the commercial insurance, property and casualty insurance, insurtech, or financial services industries.
  • Experience supporting technology or product delivery.
  • Experience using AI tools
  • Experience managing or coordinating third-party vendors and service providers.

  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements within the insurance industry.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ability to establish clear priorities, maintain accountability, and follow through on commitments.

  • Ability to facilitate productive meetings, resolve competing priorities, and drive decisions.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining highly collaborative and responsive.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to handle confidential or sensitive business information appropriately.

Working Conditions:

Additional Information

Who We Are:

Neurocrine Biosciences is a leading biopharmaceutical company with a simple purpose: to relieve suffering for people with great needs. We are dedicated to discovering, developing and commercializing life-changing treatments for patients with under-addressed neurological, psychiatric, endocrine and immunological disorders. The company's diverse portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for tardive dyskinesia, chorea associated with Huntington's disease, classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia, hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome, endometriosis* and uterine fibroids*, as well as a robust pipeline including multiple compounds in mid- to late-phase clinical development across our core therapeutic areas. For more than three decades, we have applied our unique insight into neuroscience and the interconnections between brain and body systems to treat complex conditions. We relentlessly pursue medicines to ease the burden of debilitating diseases and disorders, because you deserve brave science. For more information, visit neurocrine.com, and follow the company on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and YouTube. (*in collaboration with AbbVie)


At Neurocrine, strong leadership drives both business results and team success. We look for leaders who think strategically, anticipate what’s ahead and set clear direction, while building and empowering high-performing teams. Successful leaders foster an environment where people are motivated to do their best work and deliver meaningful, measurable impact through sound decision-making and accountability.

About the Role:

Responsible for leading and energizing a high-performing, patient-centric field sales organization to deliver sustainable business growth across specialty therapeutic areas and customer segments. Inspires a culture of purpose, accountability, and resilience while driving commercial excellence in complex and evolving markets. Leads through influence and collaboration to align teams, strategies, and stakeholders in support of organizational objectives, customer needs, and improved patient outcomes. Champions excellence in execution while shaping the future of the field organization and developing the capabilities needed to support current and future commercial opportunities.

_

Your Contributions (include, but are not limited to):

  • Lead, develop, and optimize a high-performing, patient-centric field sales organization to achieve near-term and long-term business objectives
  • Create and execute business plans for designated products, portfolios, and markets that align with overarching commercial strategy, growth objectives, and financial targets
  • Provide strategic leadership and direction to front-line field sales leaders, ensuring accountability for performance, coaching, talent development, compliance, and execution excellence
  • Drive a customer-centric field strategy that elevates the voice of healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, and other key stakeholders across critical touchpoints and informs execution across the commercial organization
  • Serve as a strong cross-functional leader, partnering closely with Marketing, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Patient Services, Analytics, Training, Compliance, and other key functions to align priorities and maximize business performance
  • Own national and/or regional business performance, including sales execution, resource deployment, expense management, and stewardship of budgets and commercial investments
  • Identify opportunities to enhance field effectiveness, optimize resource allocation, and improve execution across diverse sites of care, customer segments, and specialty distribution channels
  • In partnership with Commercial leadership, develop, communicate, and implement national sales objectives, incentive compensation programs, business strategies, and tactical plans that support a high-performing sales culture and consistent execution
  • Build trusted relationships across the enterprise to ensure cross-functional alignment, effective communication, and successful implementation of key strategies and initiatives
  • Exercise sound judgment, ensure integrity, and uphold the highest ethical and compliance standards in all field activities and customer interactions
  • Contribute to strategic planning and provide recommendations related to field force effectiveness, targeting, incentive compensation, forecasting, resource deployment, and tactical execution
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and commitment to the patients and communities served
  • Lead organizational change initiatives and support the successful implementation of evolving business strategies, operating models, capabilities, and field execution approaches
  • Serve as a visible and influential leader who promotes engagement, organizational effectiveness, and a high-performance culture
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • BS/BA degree AND 17+ years of progressive leadership experience in specialty pharmaceutical or biotech sales management, including extensive field sales management and product launch experience leading and developing others in highly complex and competitive environments. Experience managing a regional specialty sales force is preferred. Experience in building/expanding and leading a pharmaceutical/biotech sales force during rapid growth, preferably in specialty pharmaceuticals, rare disease, endocrinology, psychiatry, or neurology. OR
  • MBA preferred AND 15+ years of related experience OR
  • PhD preferred AND 12+ years of related experience
  • Ability to effectively operate in complex commercial environments that include diverse sites of care, specialty pharmacy fulfillment, long-term care settings, integrated delivery networks, and evolving customer and market dynamics
  • Proven ability, as supported by superior product and portfolio performance, to establish and achieve challenging business objectives
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively lead and develop front-line field sales leaders and their teams
  • Thorough understanding of industry standards, multiple customer segments, specialty product distribution, reimbursement, and market access fundamentals
  • Strong understanding of commercial execution within specialty pharmaceutical and biotechnology markets
  • Results-oriented and able to thrive within a fast-paced, high-energy environment
  • This position requires frequent driving; therefore, a valid driver's license, clean driving record, and ability to operate a motor vehicle are required as part of the job responsibilities
  • Acts as a trusted advisor across the organization and is recognized for sound judgment, strong leadership, and enterprise influence
  • Provides strategic direction and recommendations on issues impacting commercial execution, customer engagement, organizational effectiveness, and business performance
  • Possesses deep knowledge of specialty pharmaceutical commercialization, including field execution, customer engagement, market access dynamics, specialty distribution channels, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Demonstrates superior leadership skills with a proven ability to attract, develop, retain, and inspire top talent
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels of the organization
  • Strong managerial capability with demonstrated success coaching and developing direct and indirect reports
  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes, drive alignment, and lead through complexity and change
  • Self-motivated, decisive, detail-oriented, and able to think independently in a fast-paced environment

Neurocrine Biosciences is an EEO/Disability/Vets employer.

We are committed to building a workplace of belonging, respect, and empowerment, and we recognize there are a variety of ways to meet our requirements. We are looking for the best candidate for the job and encourage you to apply even if your experience or qualifications don’t line up to exactly what we have outlined in the job description.

The annual base salary we reasonably expect to pay is $255,000.00-$348,000.00. Individual pay decisions depend on various factors, such as primary work location, complexity and responsibility of role, job duties/requirements, and relevant experience and skills. In addition, this position is eligible participate in the Company’s quarterly incentive compensation plan, which provides the opportunity to earn additional compensation based on individual performance results. This position is also eligible to participate in our equity based long term incentive program.

Benefits offered include a retirement savings plan (with company match), paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans.

This is a front-line leadership role — commercially driven, hands-on with reps, and deeply embedded in deal execution.

We're looking for a player-coach who thrives in the trenches alongside their team. Someone who can build a high-performance coaching culture, elevate deal quality, drive predictable revenue, and develop the next generation of sales talent — all while keeping one hand firmly on the deals that matter most.

If you love building, coaching, and winning — and you want to do it with a differentiated product, a passionate team, and real ownership of outcomes — this role was made for you.

What You'll Do

  • Directly manage, coach, and develop ~6 quota-carrying Account Executives and Account Managers in a distributed team across the US

  • Own new logo and expansion ARR targets, pipeline quality, and forecast accuracy across both the acquisition and growth motions for our direct sales and account management teams

  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Product, and Enablement to align on ICP, competitive positioning, and value-based selling

  • Contribute to GTM strategy discussions as a key member of the Revenue Leadership Team

  • Model and help to reinforce Zensai's people-first, high performance and accountability culture

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, we expect you to have built a culture of coaching and accountability across your teams, and to be delivering measurable results across both new logo and expansion motions:

  • Predictable, growing new logo revenue that consistently meets or exceeds targets

  • Strong customer expansion and renewal performance — improving net revenue retention and reducing churn

  • A healthy, high-quality pipeline with strong deal control and consistent stage progression

  • Faster new hire ramp times and measurably improved win rates

  • Disciplined, accurate forecasts that leadership and the board can rely on

  • A team that is energized, developing, and proud to be part of Zensai

  • Deep cross-functional partnerships that drive pipeline velocity and customer lifetime value

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 7+ years of progressive B2B SaaS sales experience, with at least 3–5 years as a front-line sales manager (player-coach)

  • Proven track record of new logo quota attainment leading AE teams in mid-market and lower-enterprise segments (250–2,500 employees)

  • Experience leading both hunter (new logo) and farmer (expansion/renewal) sales teams

  • Deep expertise in deal inspection, structured sales methodologies (MEDDPICC strongly preferred), and pipeline management

  • Strong coaching mindset and proven experience— you develop people, not just manage pipeline

  • Data-driven approach to forecasting, pipeline management, and performance optimization

  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where execution speed matters

  • Experience managing distributed teams across multiple time zones

Preferred

  • Growth-stage SaaS experience ($20M–$100M ARR scale-up journey)

  • Experience with Microsoft-centric selling motions or HR technology / learning management / talent development solutions

  • Familiarity with Dynamics 365 CRM, Gong, Salesloft, and ZoomInfo

  • Experience building or rebuilding sales teams during organizational transformation

  • Track record of cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, RevOps, Customer Success, and Channel teams

Who You Are

  • You lead with honesty and authenticity — these aren't buzzwords at Zensai, they're prerequisites

  • You believe in Human Success: that people grow, thrive, and succeed when they are supported, coached, and empowered

  • You are a builder, not a maintainer — you thrive in transformation and see ambiguity as opportunity

  • You balance high-performance expectations with genuine care for your team's development and well-being

  • You bring energy, curiosity, and a sense of humor to your work — because we believe you can work hard and enjoy it

Why Join Zensai

  • Own the commercial engine for North America — both new logo growth and customer expansion — with real P&L impact

  • Report directly to a hands-on CBO with 25+ years of GTM leadership experience who is invested in your success

  • Sell a differentiated, Microsoft-native product suite with strong market tailwinds in AI, HR tech, and digital transformation

  • Join a company recognized as a Gartner Cool Vendor, Fosway Core Leader, and G2 Leader — customers love the product

  • Be part of a Great Place to Work — certified three years running — where culture isn't a poster on the wall, it's how we operate

  • Shape the future of a growing global SaaS company at a pivotal moment in its journey

  • A leadership team that values transparency, accountability, and putting people first — always

Equal Opportunity

Zensai is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate the unique knowledge you can offer that might not be mentioned in this job post. We appreciate diversity in all forms, and that includes the backgrounds and past experiences of our team members. A growth mindset and openness to learn are the most important to us.

raw.title: Sr. Cyberthreat Analyst (OSINT)
raw.excerpt: Specific Duties and Responsibilities:• Threat Lead Identification: Research new adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) using open sources (public information such as security vendor reporting, social media, code repositories); closed sources (dark web and underground forums); and proprietary sources.
raw.description:
Specific Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Threat Lead Identification: Research new adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) using open sources (public information such as security vendor reporting, social media, code repositories); closed sources (dark web and underground forums); and proprietary sources.
  • Subject Matter: Threat leads should focus on team priority intelligence requirements (PIRs). Examples of such subject matter include malware developments, offensive security tools, vulnerability exploits, cloud security, and mobile security.
  • Key Detail Identification: During research, identify and take note of infection chains, host and network IoCs, malware samples, threat actors, and MITRE ATT&CK tactics and techniques.
  • Author Notes: Write TTP Instances detailing identified threat leads. TTP Instances include a combination of information from open-source reporting and your own analysis (i.e. code review, static malware analysis). TTP Instances are written and formatted to help our customers understand infection chains while also helping them prepare and validate their defenses.
  • Cadence: Write at least 2 TTP Instance notes daily
  • Quality: Authored TTP Instances should include minimal grammatical or syntax errors. Plagiarism is not acceptable.
  • Malware Analysis: Using sandbox environments and static analysis tools, analyze malware samples associated with threat leads.
  • Use Cases: Malware analysis is used to provide additional insight into an event, validate open-source reporting, uncover additional IoCs, and assist peers and customers in detection engineering.
  • Detection Engineering: Create malware or vulnerability detections (e.g. YARA, Sigma, Snort, Nuclei) that can be used for threat hunting, detection, and classification.
  • Cadence: Create at least 2 malware or vulnerability detections per month
  • Delivery: These detections may be uploaded to the Client Platform on their own, or accompanied by a TTP Instance.
  • Content Review: Review TTP Instances and Malware Detections created by your peers, checking for subject matter accuracy, correct IoC identification (no false positives), MITRE ATT&CK mapping, Diamond Model mapping, and proper grammar and formatting.
  • Content Publication: Upload reviewed TTP Instances to the Client Platform while ensuring proper entity and Diamond Model tagging.
  • Information Security: Adhere to and implement our organization's quality and information security policies and carry out its processes and procedures accordingly.
  • Protect client-supplied and generated-for-client information from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction, or interference (see also Table of Offenses)
  • Carry out tasks as assigned and aligned with particular processes or activities related to information security.
  • Report any potential or committed non-conformity, observation and/or security event or risks to immediate superior.

Qualification

Required Skills

  • Strong written communication in English
  • Demonstrable experience writing reports on technical subject matter (e.g. malware, vulnerability exploits, offensive security tools) in a clear, concise, and logical format
  • Demonstrable ability to create malware detections (e.g. YARA, Sigma, Snort) with no false positives
  • Disciplined time management
  • Flexibility when working with a global team in varying timezones Self-starting, self-motivated, and thrive in a collaborative environment Ability to receive and apply constructive feedback from peers and leadership

Minimum Qualifications

  • B.S. equivalent in computer science, information systems, or cyber intelligence Four (4) years of professional experience in the Cybersecurity or Threat Intelligence industry
  • Technical proficiency in Cyber Threat Intelligence and Threat Intelligence platforms
  • Experience working with open-source intelligence (OSINT) and/or large data sets
  • Experience working with sandboxes, virtual machines, or other malware analysis tools
  • Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK Framework, including the ability map reported activity to ATT&CK tactics and techniques
  • Familiarity with interpreting and mapping cyberattacks to the Diamond Model of Intrusion Analysis
  • Adeptness in cybersecurity and data protection

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in scripting or programming languages (PHP, C, C#, C++, Python, PowerShell, Go, JavaScript, Rust)
  • Experience creating vulnerability detections (e.g. Nuclei)

raw.description:
ThoughtSpot is a Data & AI platform that helps companies turn data into enterprise advantage. We're Gartner MQ leaders with more than 1,000 customers globally and offices in Mountain View, Chicago, London, Bangalore, Sydney, and Tokyo.

The Role:

We started by giving humans a better way to ask questions of data. Spotter turned that into an AI analyst that reasons over governed enterprise data. Now we're bringing that same agentic approach deeper into Germany and the wider DACH region, backed by an enterprise customer base that already trusts ThoughtSpot with its most important decisions.

ThoughtSpot lets business users ask questions in natural language and get instant, governed answers on live data, then extends that reasoning into agentic workflows across the business. Unlike legacy BI tools that make customers wait on IT for pre-built dashboards, ThoughtSpot puts answers directly in the hands of the people asking the questions.

We're looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to own and grow ThoughtSpot's largest accounts across Germany. You'll be based in Germany, working remotely, with direct access to sales leadership, a dedicated solutions engineer, and marketing and customer success support from day one plus the full weight of an established enterprise customer base and partner network behind every deal.

Your Goal: find the enterprise plays that win in Germany, land and expand the region's flagship accounts, and build the relationships that turn first deals into a durable, repeatable book of business.

What You'll Do:

  • Own your territory. Build and run the account plan for enterprise deals across Germany, from pipeline generation to close.
  • Run complex enterprise cycles. Navigate multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations, and procurement to get to yes.
  • Build the relationship, not the transaction. Get close to economic buyers and champions, understand what they're trying to achieve, and stay the trusted partner after the deal closes.
  • Bring in the team. Pull in solutions engineering, customer success, and leadership at the right moments to move deals forward.
  • Know the platform cold. Understand Spotter, ThoughtSpot Analytics, ThoughtSpot Embedded, and ThoughtSpot Mode well enough to position the right fit for each customer's problem.
  • Forecast with discipline. Keep an accurate pipeline and flag changes early — no surprises, no excuses, at quarter close.

What You Bring:

  • Fluent verbal and written communication in English and German
  • This is a high-ownership enterprise sales role. You'll have the resources and brand of an established Gartner-leading platform behind you, and the freedom to run your territory the way you see fit.
  • You have a track record closing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise software deals, ideally in data, analytics, or AI.
  • You're fluent in German and English and understand how enterprise buyers in the DACH market make decisions.
  • You build relationships for the long term. Customers are people betting their careers on the product, not logos to close and move past.
  • You play every deal like it's the one that matters most, and you come back sharper after the ones you lose.
  • You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and building your own playbook rather than following a rigid script.
  • You collaborate naturally with solutions engineering, marketing, and customer success to win as a team.
  • You're based in Germany and can work with customers and colleagues across the DACH region and Europe.
  • We value what you've built vs your title or years of experience.

Remote Work at ThoughtSpot

This role is available as a remote position with regular travel to London and Munich for team days.

About ThoughtSpot

The world’s most innovative companies turn to ThoughtSpot’s AI-Powered Analytics to put data in the hands of everyone, from the C-suite to the frontline. With simple, natural language search and AI, anyone can ask questions, discover insights, and act with confidence. Unlike legacy tools that sacrifice performance for complexity, ThoughtSpot is intuitively designed for every business user while being built to handle the most complex, large-scale data, wherever it resides. This unique combination of speed and simplicity is why enterprise leaders trust ThoughtSpot to transform decision-making into a truly data-driven culture.

At ThoughtSpot, we’re a curious, data-driven bunch. We believe the world works better when everyone has access to facts. That’s why we build products that make asking and answering data questions as natural as having a conversation.

Mandatory and Required Skills for All ThoughtSpot Roles

Spotters are expected to demonstrate AI literacy and workflow integration to include to ability to:

  • Comfortably and confidently integrate artificial intelligence into their daily workflow to increase productivity and quality.
  • Hands-on experience to leverage AI tools (industry-leading LLMs) to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, and improve work quality.
  • Speak to the experience of using AI for research, content creation, and document summarization while maintaining ownership of judgment and final decisions.
  • Write effective prompts to get the most accurate and creative results from AI tools.

Spotters are expected to exemplify these key traits and AI Mindset:

  • Curiosity in exploring new AI tools
  • Adaptability to quickly learn and implement new, emerging AI technologies
  • Critical thinking to know when to identify when AI should be used versus when human judgement is necessary

This combination of curiosity, adaptability, and discernment defines the AI mindset, and it’s required for every role at ThoughtSpot.

AI Mindset for All Spotters

At ThoughtSpot, we believe AI is a necessary and essential part of how we work. Every role, across every team, is expected to be fluent and comfortable with using AI to do their best work.

All Spotters are expected to experiment with ThoughtSpot’s AI tools (like Spotter and SpotterViz) and leading industry LLMs to streamline workflows, enhance output, and uncover new insights. Whether drafting content, analyzing data, or summarizing documents, AI is a daily partner. We value curiosity, openness to learning, and thoughtful application of AI to create real value. Training and resources are provided so every Spotter can confidently create with AI.

ThoughtSpot for All

At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you’re a strong match, we encourage you to apply.

What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?

ThoughtSpot is the Agentic Analytics Platform that empowers every enterprise to transform insights into action, on a mission to make the world more fact driven. We hire people with unique identities, backgrounds, and perspectives - this balance-for-the-better philosophy is key to our success. When paired with our culture of Trust, Customer Obsession, Innovation and Intensity, ThoughtSpot cultivates a respectful culture that pushes norms to create world-class products. If you’re excited by the opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the business and make your mark on a truly innovative company, we invite you to read more about our mission, and apply to the role that’s right for you.

Job Summary

The Complex Claims Master Adjuster works within highest limits and authority on highly complex claim assignments. The role is responsible for the appropriate resolution of complex claims representing the highest levels of exposure and expense to the organization. The role determines coverage, investigates, analyzes, negotiates, and settles the highest and most complex claims with high corporate visibility and/or significant exposure. The role also empowers and leads claims adjusters to achieve claims management excellence, directly handles the largest and most complex claims, serving as a technical consultant and subject matter expert to business partners.

Job Responsibilities

  • Determines whether coverage exists for the type of complex claim assigned and investigates thoroughly to obtain relevant facts concerning all aspects of the claim, such as coverage, liability, legal climate, potential exposure, and damages, and makes decisions, where appropriate, on claim resolution.
  • Selects, directs, and supervises internal and external resources and experts impacting short and long-term claim results.
  • Maintains effective and ongoing communication with claims staff, internal and external business partners, insureds, claimants, agents, attorneys, other insurance companies, claims leadership, vendors/contractors, and public adjusters.
  • Establishes and reviews proper reserves for each claim based upon thorough investigation, evaluation, and experience and completes appropriate reports so that the status of the claim is clearly always documented.
  • Negotiates timely and appropriate settlements with insureds, claimants, vendors, attorneys, and other insurance companies and refers claims exceeding authority to appropriate leader with recommendations.
  • Remains current on industry topics, trends, processes, technology, best practices through research, industry events, networking, etc.
  • Assists less experienced claims professionals in the handling of large or complicated losses and actively participates in the coaching, development, training, and education of claims professionals.
  • Participates in large/complex exposure file analysis and strategy development via roundtable discussions.
  • Travels as often as needed including regular utilization of assigned fleet vehicle to cover assigned territory. May involve traveling on short notice or other daily driving duties as assigned regardless of location.

  • 10+ years of Complex Claims handling experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or related field and/or commensurate work experience.
