DEPT: DHT CLINICAL APPLICATIONS

Full-time - 8am to 5pm Monday through Friday - 100% Remote

Pharmacist Programmer/Analyst position for the Epic Willow (pharmacy) team. Pharmacist license in good standing required.

This position is responsible for application configuration, deployment and support, change documentation, and will educate and inform staff on EPIC Willow (Pharmacy) functionality. The individual will anticipate business needs and think with a business owner mind-set based on a strong fundamental knowledge of the system, and the organizational infrastructure to recommend solutions that enable the enterprise to achieve its goals. These responsibilities require the individual to stay current with the Epic Willow system and/or other relevant Pharmacy related applications. Additionally, they will coordinate across multiple and varied teams to deliver solutions for the enterprise. This position will include on call responsibilities.

Premier Health utilizes the EPIC system as the electronic medical record (EMR) in which patient health information is entered and stored for the purpose of securing patient clinical information and enhancing patient care. Premier Health employs multiple Epic Teams that specialize in a range of applications within the Epic EMR.

The Epic Willow Team is responsible for the applications that encompass Configuring Medications, Med Lists, Med Orders, Label Printing, Carts & Batches, Dispense Logic, ADS Med Dispensing, Preference Lists, Charging, Medical Device Integration and Interfaces.

Essential Duties & Functions:

  1. Responsible for the processing and implementation of approved Willow or Pharmacy related change requests within established service level agreements.
  2. Responds to assigned system incidents, providing support and assistance to all users to correct and avoid recurrence of problems.
  3. Works as a team member on projects. Dimensions of project assignments range from simple stand-alone applications to large projects.
  4. Provides back-up assistance to other team members and shares knowledge/education with fellow team members.
  5. Receives assignments and works under close supervision of his/her immediate manager or senior-level team member.
  6. Researches, learns and understands the Premier Health IT policies, procedures and practices, especially related to change management, incident handling and service level agreements.
  7. Demonstrates progressive growth in capabilities, productivity, and delivery as capability and capacity develops.
  8. Participates in projects as the Willow representative, including system design documentation, procedures, process and data flows, and may provide recommendations for system enhancements and replacements.
  9. Evaluates software and hardware products and make recommendations for improving operations or processes.
  10. Typical work hours are M-F 8am-5pm and may vary based operational need. Required to participate in a 24 x 7 on-call support rotation to meet the critical clinical and business needs of the organization.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Minimum Level of Education Required: Bachelor's degree
  • Area of study or major: Pharmacy

Licensure/Certification/Registration

  • Licensed by the Board of Pharmacy and such license is in good standing
  • Epic pharmacy product (Willow) certification preferred but not required. Must obtain within 6 months of being hired.

Experience

  • 2 years of Information Technology experience.
  • Requires knowledge of the Microsoft Office Suite of applications
  • Experience in Pharmacy, retail or hospital, preferred

Knowledge/Skills

  • Demonstrates specialized knowledge of and expertise in Epic Willow or relevant EMR systems, clinical applications, interfaces and device integration. Delivers solution sets for systems and application problems.
  • Demonstrates proficiency in all skills required to facilitate application and systems enhancements or replacements.
  • Capability to analyze and resolve system integration problems.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of Pharmacy, clinical and/or business operations.
  • Communicates effectively with users, colleagues, developers, and organizational administration.
  • Demonstrates excellent analytical skills.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional work teams with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrates advanced interpersonal skills to effectively interface with department leadership and staff, physicians, vendors, and consultants. Able to effectively communicate technical subjects to non-technical customers.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

CompTIA is a leading voice and advocate for the $5 trillion global information technology ecosystem; and the estimated 75 million industry and tech professionals who design, implement, manage, and safeguard the technology that powers the world’s economy.

Through education, training, certifications, philanthropy and market research, CompTIA promotes industry growth; the development of a highly skilled workforce and a commitment to creating an environment where innovation happens, and the opportunities and benefits made possible through technology are available to all.

Scope Summary:

The Senior Global Tax Accountant will manage the organization's global tax compliance function. This role serves as the primary internal point of contact for coordinating outside tax providers and advisors across multiple countries, ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of income tax, indirect tax (VAT/GST/sales & use tax), transfer pricing documentation, and information returns worldwide. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented tax professional who is equally comfortable managing external relationships, interpreting multi-jurisdictional tax requirements, and partnering cross-functionally with Accounting, Legal, and business teams to keep CompTIA compliant as it grows internationally.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Global Tax Provider & Compliance Management

  • Serve as the day-to-day liaison and relationship manager for outside tax preparers, advisors, and consultants across all jurisdictions in which CompTIA and its affiliated entities operate.
  • Own the global tax compliance calendar, tracking filing deadlines, extensions, and documentation requirements across federal, state/local, and international jurisdictions.
  • Coordinate the timely delivery of information needed by external providers (trial balances, financial statements, supporting schedules) to ensure accurate and on-time return preparation.
  • Review draft returns, workpapers, and filings prepared by outside providers for accuracy, completeness, and consistency with CompTIA's financial records prior to filing.
  • Manage the U.S. federal and state corporate income tax return process, working closely with outside preparers on workpapers, extensions, and estimated payments.
  • Oversee international direct and indirect tax compliance (corporate income tax, VAT/GST, withholding tax, permanent establishment considerations) in partnership with local in-country advisors.

Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, local, and foreign tax filing obligations, including registrations, estimated payments, and annual filings.
  • Monitor changes in tax law and regulations across jurisdictions and assess potential impact on CompTIA's operations and compliance obligations.
  • Prepare and/or review tax provisions, account reconciliations, and supporting documentation for financial statement purposes.
  • Support sales & use tax and VAT/GST compliance, including nexus analysis as CompTIA's global footprint evolves.
  • Manage global transfer pricing compliance, including coordinating with outside advisors on annual transfer pricing documentation (master file, local files, and country-by-country reporting as applicable), intercompany agreements, and intercompany charge calculations across jurisdictions.
  • Monitor intercompany transactions for consistency with transfer pricing policy and flag discrepancies or changes in the business that may require updated documentation or advisor review.
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready documentation and workpapers to support all filings and provider deliverables.

Process, Controls & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Identify opportunities to streamline and standardize the global tax compliance process, including provider management workflows and internal review procedures.
  • Partner with Accounting/Controllership to ensure tax filings reconcile to the general ledger and financial statements.
  • Support tax audits, notices, and inquiries from tax authorities by coordinating responses with outside providers and internal stakeholders.
  • Contribute to budgeting and forecasting of tax-related costs, including outside provider fees.

Key Performance Indicators:

  • Tax collection issues are fully diagnosed, remediated, and supported by controls that prevent recurrence.
  • An updated, comprehensive transfer pricing study is completed, and documentation is current across all relevant jurisdictions.
  • All global tax filings are completed accurately and on time, with no missed deadlines or avoidable penalties.
  • Outside tax providers have clear expectations, timely data, and consistent oversight, resulting in efficient, high-quality deliverables.
  • Tax compliance processes are well-documented, scalable, and audit-ready, with new jurisdictions validated before go-live rather than discovered after the fact.
  • Internal stakeholders view the Senior Tax Accountant as a trusted advisor who proactively flags risks and opportunities.

Additional Expectations:

  • Employees are expected to model CompTIA's values and reflect them in how they work and collaborate.
  • Participate in required and role relevant training to maintain skills, ensure compliance, and support ongoing professional development.
  • May be required to travel based on role responsibilities and business needs.
  • Please note that this job description is not intended to provide an exhaustive listing of tasks, activities, or responsibilities required of the employee in this role. Tasks, responsibilities, and duties may change without notice.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience managing or coordinating outside tax preparers, advisors, or Big 4/regional accounting firms.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal and state corporate tax compliance.
  • Working knowledge of international tax concepts, including VAT/GST, withholding tax, permanent establishment, and transfer pricing (documentation requirements, intercompany agreements, and OECD framework basics).
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to track multiple deadlines across jurisdictions simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical tax matters for non-tax stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Excel and ERP/accounting systems (e.g., NetSuite, Workday, Microsoft Dynamics).
  • Experience working within a trade association or membership-based organization is preferred.
  • Experience with tax compliance or transfer pricing software/provider portals (e.g., OneSource, CCH, Avalara) is preferred.
  • Experience diagnosing and remediating tax compliance gaps (e.g., under-collected sales tax/VAT, misconfigured tax engines, back-filing) in a growing or newly international business is preferred.

Education and/or Experience:

  • 5+ years of progressive tax experience, including exposure to multi-jurisdictional/international tax compliance (public accounting, corporate tax department, or a mix of both).
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field is required.
  • Master's in Taxation (MST), Masters in Accountancy, CPA, or equivalent is preferred.

Why Join Us:

We're a team of driven, creative problem-solvers who are passionate about empowering people to realize their full potential. We foster a collaborative and inclusive culture where ideas are welcomed, growth is encouraged, and success is celebrated. We're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners who share our vision and are eager to contribute to our purpose. If you're ready to unlock your potential and reach new heights, join us today.

Our team works hard and we recognize the importance of taking care of our own. We offer our employees a comprehensive suite of benefit offerings including:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance & FSA/HSA Plans
  • Performance bonus up to 10% of base salary
  • Unlimited PTO & 15 Paid Holidays
  • Flexible Schedules & Summer Hours
  • 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave
  • Sponsored Costco or Sam’s Membership
  • 401K Retirement Plan with 6% company match
  • Spot Bonuses for going above & beyond
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Wellness Reimbursement
  • Student Loan Repayment
  • Broadband Stipend
  • Expected compensation based on experience and qualifications – $102,000 – $110,000

CompTIA seeks excellence through diversity in its staff. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, or marital status.

Job Summary

At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.

Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.



Job Description

The Staff Product Analyst, Care at Fuze Health plays a critical role in driving operational and strategic decision-making across the business through data analysis, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration. This role is responsible for analyzing prescription processing and patient care operations, designing scalable data models, and developing dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across Finance, Product, Engineering, Growth, and Operations. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with business acumen to influence strategy, improve operational efficiency, and contribute to building a strong data-driven culture within the FuzeRx organization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operational Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis of prescription processing and patient care operations to support key business and operational decisions.
  • Data Modeling & Analytics: Design and build scalable data models that improve access to insights, enable data democratization, and support faster decision-making.
  • Dashboard Development: Design, implement, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions using SQL, Looker, Tableau, or similar BI tools to measure product and operational performance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Finance, Product, Engineering, Growth, and Operations teams to provide analytical visibility, identify opportunities, and recommend data-driven solutions.
  • Strategic Insights: Translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable business recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Data Infrastructure Support: Utilize SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis across large datasets to support reporting, operational monitoring, and strategic initiatives.
  • Business Impact & Decision Support: Influence business strategy by delivering high-quality analyses that drive measurable operational and financial impact.
  • Team & Culture Development: Contribute to the growth of the Data Science & Analytics function through peer collaboration, mentorship, process improvement, and fostering a strong data culture.
  • Continuous Improvement: Stay current with emerging analytics tools, technologies, and industry best practices to continuously improve analytical capabilities and business outcomes.

Required Experience & Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or another quantitative field.
  • 8+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related technical role.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL for data analysis, ETL design, scripting, and large-scale data extraction.
  • Strong experience building dashboards and visualizations using Looker, Tableau, or similar BI platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence business strategy and deliver measurable impact through data-driven insights.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills with a strong focus on actionable outcomes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex insights to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally in fast-paced, data-driven environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently while driving projects forward.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience within the healthcare or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Experience supporting supply chain optimization, logistics, or marketplace operations.
  • Programming experience with Python or similar languages.
  • Experience working with large-scale operational or healthcare datasets.



Additional Information

Additional Physical Job Requirements

Physical requirements for this role include the ability to work at a computer terminal with monitor, keyboard and mouse for extended periods of time, stoop, bend, and reach for equipment and supplies, make frequent repetitive motions required to operate a computer that include the wrists, hands and fingers, and lift, carry, push, pull, and move light objects up to 20 pounds. The role also requires the ability to effectively communicate through verbal interactions, discern auditory information, and visually perceive details to perform essential job functions.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and similar applicable state laws, it is Fuze Health’s policy to provide reasonable accommodation to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship.

Salary and Benefits

Salary Range: $149,600 - $187,000

Commission Eligible: No

Travel: Yes - Required up to 10% of the time

Location Requirement:

  • Alto is limited to individuals residing in the following states: Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Florida, Kansas, Maryland, Missouri, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Washington (WA), and Wisconsin.

Employment Authorization Requirement: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.

Benefits: Full-time employee benefits include: dental, vision, and multiple group medical plans to choose from, a 401(k) retirement savings plan, group life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, flexible spending account (FSA) and health savings account (HSA), commuter benefits, employer-paid short-term (STD) and long-term disability (LTD) insurance, and additional supplemental insurance plans (spouse life insurance, legal insurance, an employee assistance program, home health testing kits, and a fertility medication discount program). Employees are also provided flexible vacation time, accrued paid sick time, 10 paid holidays, (2 floating holidays for full time non-exempt employees) , and eight weeks of paid parental leave for eligible employees, additional paid weeks for the birthing parent, 4 weeks paid caregiver leave, and a Lifestyle Spending Account allowance each month.

More Benefits Information Here: Fuze Health Benefits Site

Application deadline: July 15, 2026

Equal Opportunity Employer

If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation during any portion of the application or hiring process, please contact us at .

Who we are:

Midi Health is the only comprehensive virtual care clinic for women in midlife navigating perimenopause, menopause, and other common midlife health challenges. Our platform provides care designed by experts, scaled by technology, and delivered by trained and compassionate clinicians.

We accept most major PPO insurance products, and we offer convenient access to clinical care through telehealth visits, 24/7 messaging, and responsible prescribing of medications, supplements, and other therapies.

We’re passionately focused on improving the symptoms of women’s midlife hormone change because the current system too often leaves women misdiagnosed and undertreated. At Midi, we’re changing that.

Where we’re based:

We are an entirely virtual company, so employees can live anywhere in the United States.

Who you are:

Midi is seeking an experienced Master Scheduler to join our cutting edge healthcare start-up. This is a rare opportunity to start at the ground level of a fast-growing healthcare practice. We offer a flexible work schedule and 100% remote environment.

Core Responsibilities

  • Process clinician time off, schedule changes, and Clinician Hub requests following established guidelines.
  • Complete assigned queue expectations, updating availability, administrative blocks, and recurring adjustments.
  • Manage patient rescheduling workflows resulting from schedule updates.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and ticket categorization.
  • Prioritize requests by urgency and patient impact, maintaining ownership through resolution and escalating barriers promptly.

Cross-Functional Responsibilities

Team members may be cross-trained and assigned across Scheduling work-streams based on business need, volume, coverage, and demonstrated proficiency. This may include:

  • Urgent Scheduling Support: Manage urgent callouts, disruptions, and time-sensitive patient rescheduling.
  • Schedule Building: Build and maintain schedules, templates, appointment durations, and ramp schedules, auditing for accuracy.
  • Queue Flexing & Coverage: Adapt dynamically across queues and provide backup support during PTO, volume spikes, or launches.
  • Special Projects & Learning: Support onboarding/offboarding, process testing, cleanups, and ongoing cross-training.

Note: Scheduling Specialists are expected to maintain proficiency across multiple workflows, with primary assignments shifting based on operational demand.

Minimum Requirements:

The qualified candidate will have experience in the following:

  • Minimum of 1 year experience working for a digital healthcare company is required
  • Minimum of five (5) years as a Clinical Scheduler building clinician schedules in AthenaHealth
  • 5+ years using AthenaHealth (Athena) required
  • Proficiency in scheduling across multiple time zones
  • Strong attention to detail

Hours: The scheduling commitment for this role is as follows: Sunday through Thursday, 9:30am - 6pm PST.

What we offer:

  • Compensation: $30/hour, non-exempt
  • Full Time, 40-hour work-week
  • Fully remote, work from home opportunity with a work-from-home monthly stipend
  • Benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k)

At this time, Midi is unable to provide visa sponsorship. All Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship needs.

Please note that all official communication from Midi Health will come from an @joinmidi.com email address. We will never ask for payment of any kind during the application or hiring process. If you receive any suspicious communication claiming to be from Midi Health, please report it immediately by emailing us at .

Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

Job Description:

Reporting to the VP of Digital, this role will support content SEO, reporting and analytics, technical SEO execution, and ongoing website optimization efforts tied to a large-scale website modernization and migration initiative. This is a highly collaborative role embedded within the Web Operations organization and partnering closely with Content, Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, Development, and Design teams.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving enterprise environment where priorities evolve and cross-functional coordination is critical.

What You’ll Do

Content SEO & Optimization

  • Conduct keyword research to support content creation, optimization, and product alignment initiatives
  • Build SEO content briefs including target keywords, search intent, content structure recommendations, and internal linking opportunities
  • Audit existing content for optimization opportunities, cannibalization, thin content, and keyword drift
  • Support TOFU and MOFU content planning aligned to business priorities and product taxonomy
  • Optimize and score content using SEO optimization tools such as Clearscope
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Content teams to validate content opportunities before production

SEO Analytics & Reporting

  • Build and maintain recurring SEO dashboards and reporting in GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, or Power BI
  • Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic trends, CTR, impressions, and conversion performance
  • Analyze traffic fluctuations and identify potential causes including algorithm changes, migration impacts, and seasonality
  • Connect organic search performance to pipeline and conversion outcomes
  • Present findings and recommendations in clear, business-friendly language

Technical SEO Support

  • Conduct technical SEO audits using tools such as Screaming Frog and Sitebulb
  • Identify and troubleshoot crawl, indexation, canonical, redirect, and hreflang issues
  • Support migration QA and redirect validation efforts across web properties
  • Assist with structured data and schema markup implementation in partnership with development teams
  • Monitor Core Web Vitals and communicate recommendations to technical stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Web Operations, Development, Design, Content, and Product Marketing teams on SEO initiatives
  • Manage SEO-related tasks and workflows through Wrike
  • Communicate SEO recommendations and technical requirements clearly across technical and non-technical teams
  • Support broader AI search visibility and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) initiatives as the organization evolves its search strategy

Required Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of hands-on SEO experience in a B2B, SaaS, or enterprise environment
  • Strong experience with content SEO, keyword research, and content brief development
  • Experience using GA4 and Google Search Console for SEO reporting and analysis
  • Familiarity with SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and Clearscope
  • Ability to translate SEO data into actionable business insights
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise website migrations and redirect validation
  • Familiarity with Looker Studio or Power BI reporting
  • Understanding of technical SEO concepts including canonicals, hreflang, schema markup, and crawl optimization
  • Experience working within multi-brand or multi-product organizations
  • Exposure to modern CMS or JAMstack environments such as Astro, Storyblok, or Vercel
  • Familiarity with AI search visibility and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) concepts
  • Experience using project management platforms such as Wrike

raw.title: Lead Data Engineer
raw.excerpt: Firmable is the market-leading B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia-Pacific.
raw.description:
Firmable is the market-leading B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia-Pacific. Our competitive moat is our data: the deepest, most localised company and people dataset in every market we operate in. We've proven the model in ANZ. Now we're scaling it across Southeast Asia and the US.

Every record Firmable sells starts in a sourcing pipeline. This role architects that pipeline.

The Role

Lead Data Engineer: Sourcing designs and owns the end-to-end extraction and ETL pipeline that turns unstructured web data into the world's most accurate B2B dataset across 13 markets. You set the architectural standards: extractor patterns, proxy strategy, LLM infrastructure as production systems, agentic escalation workflows, and cost-aware orchestration.

This is not a pipeline maintenance or incremental optimisation role. You're architecting the framework other engineers ship into, building for the hardest extraction problems (anti-bot defences, JS-heavy rendering, schema drift), and owning the sourcing layer end to end.

~80% hands-on architecture and reference implementation: designing extractor frameworks, shipping the hardest extractors, building agentic pipelines, writing eval harnesses and labelled datasets. ~20% cross-functional voice: technical input on sourcing decisions with data platform, product, and analytics; setting standards for coverage, schema, and accuracy.

What You'll Own

Data Sourcing and ETL architecture

  • End-to-end pipeline design: extraction, normalisation, deduplication, validation, and load; plus cost, performance, and reliability of the whole layer

  • Sourcing layer standards: coverage, accuracy, schema design; the rule-vs-LLM standard codified so the team applies it without you

  • Cost and performance optimisation: cost ceilings with the token math behind them, incremental processing, recovery design, scheduling

Extraction systems and frameworks

  • Extractor framework: patterns, abstractions, and tooling other engineers ship into; new extractors are fast to build and reliable to run

  • Hard-source extractors: anti-bot defences, JS-heavy rendering, schema drift, low-quality structure; plus the proxy and IP rotation strategy behind them

  • Agentic extraction pipelines: rule-based triage, LLM escalation, structured-output validation, retries, human-review queues

LLM infrastructure and observability

  • LLMs as production systems: versioned prompts, labelled eval sets, measured precision and recall, prompt versioning you can roll back, judges debugged on real data

  • Eval and observability scaffolding: eval frameworks, prompt versioning, traces, drift detection when a vendor silently updates a model

  • Model-choice playbook: cheap models for classification, stronger models for nuanced extraction, frontier models for hard edge cases; revised as model economics shift

Skills library and orchestration

  • Skills library: versioned specs for recurring extraction patterns, invocable by engineers and agents alike

  • Orchestration: Airflow or equivalent patterns that scale with data volumes and source counts; dependency management, recovery, cost-aware scheduling

What We're Looking For

Must Haves

  • 6-10 years shipping production extraction, ETL, or data pipeline systems in business-critical environments; deep web extraction at scale with experience designing around anti-bot defences, proxy architecture, JS rendering, schema drift, and recovery

  • Shipped LLMs inside extraction pipelines as production systems: structured outputs, versioned prompts, labelled eval sets, logged traces, judges debugged on precision/recall, drift detected on vendor model updates. You can show the repo.

  • Built agents and tool-calling pipelines: architected agent workflows, written specs others depend on, run tool-calling systems in production

  • Sharp judgement on rules vs. LLMs: reach for deterministic logic first, defend the call either way, and have codified the standard for a team

  • Expert Python: production-grade, performance-aware, comfortable with concurrency and scale; plus advanced SQL for complex transformations and performance optimisation

  • Extensive Airflow or equivalent: orchestration, dependency management, recovery patterns, cost optimisation at production scale

  • Shipped with agentic IDEs: Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent as your default mode, with shipped extraction systems to show for it

  • Architecture judgement and a product mindset: when to refactor, optimise, ship, or start again; you care about coverage and accuracy landing with customers, not uptime metrics

  • You live and breathe AI tools. Structured outputs, evals, traces, and LLM tracing (Logfire, OpenTelemetry, similar) as your default way of working, not a productivity experiment. In 2026, this is how data engineers build extraction at scale and you need to already be doing it.

Highly Valued

  • Cloud data platforms: Snowflake, Redshift; AWS for pipeline deployment (Lambda, S3, ECS, Glue)

  • Vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval patterns for matching and deduplication

  • Eval frameworks like Braintrust, Promptfoo, or Inspect; LLM tracing tooling

  • Data quality frameworks with automated testing and anomaly detection at scale

  • B2B data: firmographics, people data, company registries across markets

  • Data privacy and compliance: GDPR, CCPA

  • Startup or scaleup experience where you shipped fast and owned outcomes end to end

The Environment

Firmable runs lean and ships fast: small senior teams, no layers, minimal process. Sourcing is a core competitive advantage; this role sets the pace for how fast and accurate the entire data pipeline moves. Weekly releases moving toward daily; no fixed hours, full autonomy on architecture choices.

We are an AI-native organisation. That means AI isn't a tool we reach for: it's the default operating mode. Agentic extraction pipelines, LLM-powered classification with eval sets, structured-output validation, labelled datasets versioned with prompt runs, traces logged from day one with cost and latency baked in. If you're not already working this way, this role isn't right for you.

Why This Role

  • Own the sourcing engine: every record Firmable sells starts in the pipeline you architect; your design shapes the accuracy and cost of every customer interaction

  • Greenfield AI-native architecture: the extractor framework, skills library, eval harnesses, agentic orchestration, and production LLM infrastructure are largely unbuilt; you'll architect them from first principles

  • Frontier technical problems: agentic extraction at production scale, LLM-as-extractor with full eval coverage, vendor model drift detection, rule-vs-LLM orchestration across 13 markets

  • Small team, massive leverage: your architecture reaches every Firmable customer, every day; you write the reference implementation daily and own outcomes end to end

  • Real career runway: this role is a bottleneck role; progress is measured by pipeline speed and accuracy, not tenure

Who This Role is NOT For

  • Anyone looking to optimise an existing pipeline rather than architect from first principles

  • Anyone who treats infrastructure as someone else's problem; sourcing architecture lives in your code every day

  • Anyone who sees LLMs as a parsing shortcut rather than production systems that need eval sets, versioning, and drift detection

  • Anyone uncomfortable shipping with minimal process or without an established playbook to follow

  • Anyone who treats AI as something they'll learn on the job rather than already use daily in infrastructure work

  • Anyone coming from a pure ops or data analytics background without shipped systems engineering at scale

About Offprem Technology

We are a team of talented, highly skilled professionals in Salesforce consulting. Our consultants are some of the best in the industry and focus on all Salesforce, all the time. We’ve been around since 2016 and although we are headquartered in Indiana, we are remote friendly and hire across the United States. Whether you are an experienced consultant or you are interested in starting a career in the Salesforce ecosystem, we want to hear from you! Interested? Keep reading to see if this role is right for you!

About the role

The Salesforce Solution Consultant will support ongoing Salesforce CRM Core and FSC/ Financial Services Cloud initiatives across multiple client engagements. Candidates must have 1-3+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Solution Consultant, with strong core platform expertise including Financial Services, Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. In addition data modeling, security and sharing, automation (Flows, validation rules, approval processes), reporting and dashboards, Lightning Experience configuration, and integration concepts (APIs, data imports, and system connectivity) experience is necessary. This role requires the ability to translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions, provide technical guidance, and ensure best-practice implementations. Must be authorized to work in the United States; corp-to-corp arrangements are not permitted. This is a 100% remote role, open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead solution discovery and technical design across multiple Salesforce clouds and implementations
  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable Salesforce solutions
  • Guide discovery, lead design sessions, and facilitate stakeholder alignment through successful completion of projects
  • Deliver fixed-scope or rapid implementation projects.
  • Work as part of a project team alongside both internal and external clients
  • Mentor internal team members and contribute to the technical standards and best practices
  • Demonstrate genuine passion for Salesforce solutions and fostering team collaboration

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator certification
  • Ability to run discovery sessions, document requirements, and translate them into scalable configurations
  • Experience delivering fixed-scope or rapid implementation projects using Salesforce best practices
  • Hands-on experience implementing Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud. Strong emphasis on Sales, Financial Services and Experience Clouds
  • Experience with Digital Lending/ Origination is a strong plus
  • Experience with agile delivery models and consulting environments
  • 1+ years proven success in client facing roles such as a Solution Architect, Technical Lead or Senior Consultant
  • Strong grasp of Salesforce architecture, configuration, automation (Flows) and integration best practices
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to present technical concepts to business stakeholders
  • Ability to work across disciplines and adapt to unfamiliar technologies or business processes
  • 1-3 years of Salesforce solution design and delivery experience, preferably in a consulting or partner environment
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce data model, security, and standard automation tools (Flows, validation rules, approvals)
  • Experience supporting data imports, basic integrations, and go-live readiness including deployment best practices

raw.description:
Lead Generation Specialist | Transport & Logistics | B2B (Remote)

Work From Home | Full-Time | AU Market | Finding Businesses With Transport Needs

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive Lead Generation Specialist whose primary responsibility is to identify and qualify Australian businesses that require transport, freight, courier, warehousing, or logistics services.

The role focuses on finding companies that ship boxes, pallets, machinery, containers, or have ongoing B2B freight needs and then securing warm, qualified leads for the Sales & Operations Team.

This is a high-impact role for growing transport volume, routes, and long-term freight contracts.

Core Purpose of the Role

Your job is to find businesses that need transport.

This includes businesses that:

  • Send or receive pallets, cartons, bulky goods, machinery, equipment, or containers.

  • Require courier services, metro deliveries, or interstate freight.

  • Need regular weekly deliveries to customers or warehouses.

  • Have recurring B2B shipping needs but want better rates or service reliability.

  • Are unhappy with their current transport provider.

  • Are expanding, relocating, or adding new routes.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Identification Finding Businesses That Ship Freight

  • Research Australian businesses that regularly move goods.

  • Use tools such as Google Maps, ABN Lookup, LinkedIn, industry directories, B2B supplier lists, and warehousing precinct searches.

  • Identify companies in commercial/industrial zones that likely have daily or weekly freight requirements.

  • Build targeted prospect lists based on shipping frequency, industry, and transport volumes.

Outbound Lead Generation

  • Call businesses to identify whether they currently use transport providers.

  • Ask structured qualification questions:

    • What freight do they ship? (boxes, pallets, machinery, etc.)

    • How often do they ship? (daily, weekly, monthly)

    • Destinations (local, interstate, metro/regional)

    • Pain points with current provider (price, delays, damages, no tracking, poor service)

  • Generate warm, qualified leads and book appointments for the Sales Team.

CRM & Pipeline Management

  • Log all leads, notes, and follow-up tasks in the CRM.

  • Track lead status from cold warm booked converted.

  • Prepare weekly summary reports of lead volume, opportunities created, and industry insights.

Support to Sales & Operations

  • Provide clear handover notes including freight type, quantity, pricing expectations, and frequency.

  • Assist with obtaining details required for preliminary quotes (pickup and delivery suburbs, pallet counts, weights, etc.).

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2-5 years in outbound sales, lead generation, telesales, or B2B customer service.

  • Experience finding B2B customers for transport/logistics is highly advantageous.

  • Australian market experience preferred (familiar with metro freight patterns and industrial zones).

  • Strong phone communication and confidence calling Australian businesses.

  • Able to quickly identify whether a business ships freight.

  • Excellent researching and list-building ability.

  • Strong objection handling and ability to create interest.

  • Organised, reliable, and comfortable managing a high-volume lead funnel.

Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

Looking for candidates in Texas.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Small Business Advocate serves as a critical connector between field leadership and local communities, with a focus on supporting small businesses in low‑ to moderate‑income neighborhoods. The role promotes sustainable economic growth by ensuring business owners have access to the resources, guidance, and opportunities needed to thrive.


This position also supports the Bank’s Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) objectives by advancing small business development, expanding community outreach, and promoting equitable access to financial solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Community Engagement

  • Build strong, trust‑based relationships with small business owners in low‑ to moderate‑income neighborhoods.
  • Serve as a dedicated advocate, understanding and elevating the needs of local business owners.
  • Collaborate with Community Development Financial Institutions (CDFIs) to broaden access to capital and technical assistance.
  • Contribute to CRA‑eligible community development activities that advance local economic vitality.

Collaboration with Field Leadership

  • Partner with regional and local leadership to identify outreach opportunities and expand support through Special Purpose Credit Programs (SPCPs).
  • Provide insights that strengthen program design and enhance support for small businesses.
  • Coordinate Place‑Based initiatives across the Bank’s footprint.
  • Support leadership in identifying, documenting, and communicating activities aligned with CRA goals.

Resource Connection

  • Connect small businesses with financial solutions, educational tools, and networking opportunities.
  • Promote programs that enhance access to capital, mentorship, and operational guidance.
  • Ensure outreach activities reinforce equitable access to credit in alignment with CRA expectations.

Advocacy & Education

  • Facilitate workshops, seminars, and events that equip small business owners with practical knowledge and best practices.
  • Advocate for fair and consistent access to financial products and services tailored to the needs of small businesses.
  • Participate in activities that may qualify for CRA service hours when applicable.

Performance & Impact Tracking

  • Track engagement, program participation, and overall impact across key initiatives.
  • Identify gaps and trends to inform strategic improvements.
  • Support documentation and reporting of CRA‑related activities in accordance with regulatory standards.

Other Duties

Perform additional responsibilities as assigned, adapting to evolving business needs and organizational priorities.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

This role is ideal for individuals passionate about strengthening local economies and empowering small businesses in low‑ to moderate‑income neighborhoods through targeted support and resource connection.

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Community Development, or a related field—or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years in small business development, community outreach, advocacy, or similar fields; exposure to CRA or community development is advantageous.
  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of challenges and opportunities specific to small businesses operating in low‑ to moderate‑income areas.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional relationship‑building, communication, and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Agility: Ability to work effectively across teams and adapt to dynamic business environments.

SKILLS FOR SUCCESS

Candidates who thrive in this role often bring:

  • Direct experience supporting small businesses in low‑ to moderate‑income communities.
  • Working knowledge of financial products and services used by small businesses.
  • Familiarity with CRA community development concepts and industry best practices.
  • Multilingual abilities, which support broader engagement and inclusion.

DOING THE RIGHT THING

At Fifth Third Bank, we take pride in doing what is right for our customers, colleagues, and communities. We openly exchange ideas, raise concerns, and follow policies that protect our people and our mission—ensuring we remain accountable stewards of our shared success.

As a Fifth Third Bank team member, you will be responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and personally following policies and procedures as defined. You will be accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues and ensuring that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the risk appetites of Fifth Third Bank, you will be expected to achieve results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.

This opportunity offers the ability to shape district sales strategy, lead successful product launches, develop future sales talent, drive market share growth, expand customer engagement, and influence business outcomes across a dynamic ophthalmology and pharmaceutical sales organization while making a meaningful impact on patients, providers, and the communities we serve.


In this role, a typical day will include:

  • Recruit, hire, onboard, and retain top sales talent while fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture.
